title.zh: 卷四 魏本紀第四: 世宗宣武帝 肅宗孝明帝
title.en: Volume 4 Wei Annals 4: Emperor Shizong Xuanwen, Emperor Suzong Xiaoming
title.raw: 卷四 魏本紀第四: 世宗宣武帝 肅宗孝明帝 Volume 4 Wei Annals 4: Emperor Shizong Xuanwen, Emperor Suzong Xiaoming

sentences.zh: 世宗宣武帝

translations.literal: Emperor Shizong Xuanwu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong Xuanwu.

sentences.zh: 世宗宣武皇帝諱恪，孝文皇帝第二子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizong Xuanwu, taboo name Ke, was the second son of Emperor Xiaowen.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanwu the Grand Successor, taboo name Ke, was Xiaowen's second son.

sentences.zh: 母曰高夫人。

translations.literal: His mother was Lady Gao.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Lady Gao.

sentences.zh: 初，夢為日所逐，避於床下。

translations.literal: At first she dreamed the sun pursued her and she hid under the bed.
translations.idiomatic: Before his birth she dreamed the sun chased her and she took refuge beneath the bed.

sentences.zh: 日化為龍，繞己數匝，寤而驚悸，遂有娠。

translations.literal: The sun became a dragon, circled her several times; waking in fright and trembling, she conceived.
translations.idiomatic: The sun turned into a dragon and coiled about her many times; she woke in terror and soon carried the child.

sentences.zh: 太和七年閏四月，生帝於平城宮。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month of the seventh year of Taihe, the Emperor was born in the Pingcheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the leap fourth month of Taihe year seven he was born in the Pingcheng palace.

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月丙申，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-first year, on bingchen day, he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year twenty-one, on bingchen day, he was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 二十三年四月丙午，孝文帝崩。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-third year, on bingwu day, Emperor Xiaowen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year twenty-three, on bingwu day, Xiaowen died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太子即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On dingsi day the crown prince took the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the heir ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 諒暗，委政宰輔。

translations.literal: In mourning seclusion, he entrusted government to his chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: He kept mourning seclusion and left rule to his chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 五月，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Goguryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，分遣侍臣，巡行州郡，問人疾苦，考察守令，黜陟幽明，褒禮名賢。

translations.literal: On yimao day in the sixth month, he dispatched attendant officials to tour the provinces and commanderies, inquire into the people's hardships, examine local magistrates, dismiss the obscure and promote the clear, and honor eminent worthies.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the sixth month he sent courtiers through the provinces to hear the people's woes, judge the magistrates, purge the dim and raise the bright, and honor men of renown.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，追尊皇妣曰文昭皇后。

translations.literal: On wuchen day he posthumously honored his imperial mother as Empress Wenzhao.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he raised his birth mother to Empress Wenzhao.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊申，遵遺詔，孝文皇帝三夫人已下，悉免歸家。

translations.literal: On wushen day in the eighth month of autumn, in accordance with the testamentary edict, all consorts of Emperor Xiaowen from the third rank down were sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the eighth autumn month, obeying Xiaowen's deathbed order, every consort from the third rank down was released to her family.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，增宮臣位一級。

translations.literal: On guichou day he advanced palace officials one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he raised every palace officer one step in rank.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，鄧至國王象舒彭來朝。

translations.literal: On guiwei day in the tenth month of winter, the king of Dengzhi, Xiang Shupeng, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the tenth winter month Xiang Shupeng, king of Dengzhi, presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，謁長陵。

translations.literal: On bingxu day he visited Changling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he went to Changling.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，享太廟。

translations.literal: On dingyou day he offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he sacrificed at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月，幽州人王惠定聚眾反，自稱明法皇帝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Wang Huiding of Youzhou gathered a crowd in rebellion and styled himself Emperor Mingfa.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Wang Huiding of Youzhou rose with a host and called himself Emperor Mingfa.

sentences.zh: 刺史李肅捕斬之。

translations.literal: The inspector Li Su captured and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Li Su seized and executed him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，州鎮十八水饑，分遣使者，開倉振恤。

translations.literal: That year eighteen prefectures and garrisons suffered flood and famine; envoys were sent in separate parties to open the granaries and relieve distress.
translations.idiomatic: That year flood and famine struck eighteen districts; the court sent envoys to open storehouses and succor the hungry.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙申朔，謁長陵。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year, on bingshen day, the first day of the first month, he visited Changling.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year two, on the first day of the first month, bingshen, he visited Changling.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，帝始親政。

translations.literal: On gengxu day the Emperor began to rule in person.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he took personal charge of government.

sentences.zh: 遵遺詔。

translations.literal: In accordance with the testamentary edict.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the testamentary edict.

sentences.zh: 聽司徒、彭城王勰以老歸第。

translations.literal: He permitted the Minister of Education, Prince of Pengcheng Xie, to retire home on account of age.
translations.idiomatic: He allowed Minister of Education Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, to withdraw in old age.

sentences.zh: 進太尉、咸陽王禧位太保，以司空、北海王詳為大將軍、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: He advanced the Grand Commandant, Prince of Xianyang Xi, to Grand Tutor, and appointed the Minister of Works, Prince of Beihai Xiang, Grand General and Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: He promoted Grand Commandant Xi of Xianyang to Grand Tutor and named Minister of Works Xiang of Beihai Grand General with charge of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，引見群臣於太極前殿，告以覽政之意。

translations.literal: On dingsi day he summoned the ministers before the Hall of Supreme Ultimate and announced his intent to oversee government.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he received the ministers in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate and declared that he would govern himself.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以太保、咸陽王禧領太尉，以大將軍、廣陵王羽為司空。

translations.literal: On renxu day he made Grand Tutor Xi, Prince of Xianyang, Grand Commandant, and Grand General Yu, Prince of Guangling, Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he named Grand Tutor Xi of Xianyang Grand Commandant and Grand General Yu of Guangling Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 分遣大使。

translations.literal: He dispatched great envoys in separate parties.
translations.idiomatic: He sent high commissioners abroad.

sentences.zh: 黜陟幽明。

translations.literal: He dismissed the obscure and promoted the clear.
translations.idiomatic: He purged the unfit and advanced the worthy.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，進宿衛之官位一級。

translations.literal: On gengwu day in the second month he advanced the palace guard one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the second month he raised the palace guard one rank.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大赦。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day he proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he pardoned the realm.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未朔，詔以比年連有軍旅，正調之外，皆蠲罷。

translations.literal: On yimao day, the first day of the third month, an edict ordered that, because of continuous campaigning in recent years, all levies beyond the regular tax were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, yimao, he ordered every extraordinary levy beyond the regular tax remitted for the years of war.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，青、齊、徐、兗四州大饑，人死者萬餘口。

translations.literal: On renxu day Qing, Qi, Xu, and Yan provinces suffered great famine; more than ten thousand people died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu famine in Qing, Qi, Xu, and Yan killed more than ten thousand souls.

sentences.zh: 是月，齊雍州刺史蕭衍奉其南康王寶融為主，東赴建鄴。

translations.literal: That month Xiao Yan, Inspector of Yong Province in Qi, installed his Prince of Nankang, Bao Rong, as ruler and marched east toward Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiao Yan of Qi set up Prince Bao Rong of Nankang and marched east on Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 詔洛陽令有大事，聽面敷奏。

translations.literal: An edict allowed the magistrate of Luoyang, on great affairs, to memorialize in person.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that the magistrate of Luoyang might present grave matters face to face.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，元英攻拔義陽。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Yuan Ying captured Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Yuan Ying took Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，英又大破梁軍，仍清三關。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Ying again routed the Liang army and cleared the three passes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Ying smashed the Liang forces again and cleared the three passes.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，封英為中山王。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Ying was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Ying was made Prince of Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔諸州蠲停徭役，不得橫有征發。

translations.literal: In the ninth month an edict ordered the provinces to suspend corvée and forbade unauthorized levies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he ordered the provinces to halt corvée and forbid arbitrary exactions.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕犯塞，詔左僕射源懷討之。

translations.literal: The Rouran raided the frontier; an edict ordered the Left Vice Minister Yuan Huai to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Rouran struck the border he sent Left Vice Minister Yuan Huai against them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，詔斷群臣白衣募吏。

translations.literal: On yimao day in the tenth month of winter an edict forbade ministers to recruit clerks in plain dress.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the tenth winter month he forbade ministers to hire private clerks in civilian dress.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，詔有司依漢、魏舊章，營繕國學。

translations.literal: On wuwu day in the eleventh month an edict ordered the relevant offices, following the old statutes of Han and Wei, to repair the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the eleventh month he ordered the offices to restore the National University by Han and Wei precedent.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，以苑牧公田分賜代遷戶。

translations.literal: On bingzi day in the twelfth month he distributed the public fields of the park herds to households relocated from Dai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the twelfth month he granted the park herds' public fields to families moved from Dai.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔群臣議定律令。

translations.literal: On jimao day an edict ordered the ministers to deliberate on fixing laws and ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he charged the ministers to draft laws and ordinances.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸卯朔，行梁州事夏侯道遷據漢中來降。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the first day of the intercalary month, Xiahou Daqian, acting for Liang Province, held Hanzhong and came over in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the leap month, guimao, Xiahou Daqian, holding Hanzhong for Liang Province, surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以高陽王雍為司空。

translations.literal: On yichou day Prince of Gaoyang Yong was appointed Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗遣使來朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙子，封宕昌世子梁彌博為宕昌王。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, on bingzi day, the heir of Dangchang, Liang Mibo, was enfeoffed as King of Dangchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year two, on bingzi day, Liang Mibo, heir of Dangchang, was made King of Dangchang.

sentences.zh: 二月，梁州氐、蜀反，絕漢中運路，州刺史邢巒頻大破之。

translations.literal: In the second month the Di and Shu of Liang Province rebelled, cutting the Hanzhong supply route; the provincial inspector Xing Luan repeatedly routed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Di and Shu of Liang rose and severed the road to Hanzhong; Inspector Xing Luan beat them again and again.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，城陽王鸞薨。

translations.literal: On jiwei day in the fourth month of summer Prince of Chengyang Luan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the fourth summer month Luan, Prince of Chengyang, died.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔曰：「中正所銓，但為門第，吏部彜倫，仍不才舉。

translations.literal: On yichou day an edict said: "What the Rectifiers weigh is only family standing; the Ministry of Personnel still promotes the untalented.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he proclaimed: "The Rectifiers judge only pedigree; the Ministry still advances men without talent.

sentences.zh: 八坐可審議往代擢賢之禮，必令才學並申，資望兼致。

translations.literal: The Eight Ministers should carefully deliberate the methods by which past dynasties raised the worthy, so that talent and learning are both displayed and qualifications and repute are both attained."
translations.idiomatic: Let the Eight Ministers study how former ages chose the able, so that learning and office, merit and name, rise together."

sentences.zh: 」邢巒遣統軍王足西伐，頻破梁諸軍，遂入劍閣。

translations.literal: Xing Luan sent the army commander Wang Zu on a western campaign; he repeatedly defeated the Liang armies and entered Jian Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Luan sent Wang Zu west; Zu broke the Liang hosts again and again and entered Jian Pass.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，王足擊破梁軍，因逼涪城。

translations.literal: On wuzi day in the seventh month of autumn Wang Zu defeated the Liang army and pressed on Fucheng.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the seventh autumn month Wang Zu routed the Liang army and closed on Fucheng.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，詔中山王英南討襄沔。

translations.literal: On renyin day in the eighth month an edict ordered Prince of Zhongshan Ying to campaign south against Xiang and Mian.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the eighth month he sent Prince Ying of Zhongshan south against Xiang and Mian.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊辰朔，武興王楊紹先叔父集起謀反，詔光祿大夫楊椿討之。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the first day of the eleventh month of winter, the uncle of King Shaoxian of Wuxing, Jiqi, plotted rebellion; an edict ordered the Household Minister Yang Chun to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh winter month, wuchen, Jiqi, uncle of King Shaoxian of Wuxing, rebelled; the court sent Household Minister Yang Chun against him.

sentences.zh: 王足圍涪城，益州諸郡戍降者十二三，送編籍者五萬餘戶。

translations.literal: Wang Zu besieged Fucheng; of the garrison commanderies of Yizhou, twelve or thirteen submitted, and more than fifty thousand households sent registers.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zu invested Fucheng; a dozen Yizhou garrisons surrendered and fifty thousand households sent in their registers.

sentences.zh: 既而足引軍退。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Zu withdrew his army.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Zu drew his army back.

sentences.zh: 是歲，鄧至國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Dengzhi sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁卯朔，皇子昌生，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, on dingmao day, the first day of the month, the prince Chang was born; a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third year, dingmao, Prince Chang was born and the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 壬申，梁、秦二州刺史邢巒連破氐賊，克武興。

translations.literal: On renshen day the inspectors of Liang and Qin, Xing Luan, repeatedly defeated the Di bandits and took Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Xing Luan, inspector of Liang and Qin, broke the Di rebels again and took Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 秦州人王智等聚眾，自號王公，尋推秦州主簿呂茍兒為主，年號建明。

translations.literal: Wang Zhi and others of Qinzhou gathered a crowd, styled themselves Duke and King; soon they installed Lü Gouer, chief clerk of Qinzhou, as ruler, with the era name Jianming.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhi of Qinzhou raised a host as Duke and King, then set up Lü Gouer, Qinzhou chief clerk, as ruler under the era name Jianming.

sentences.zh: 己卯，楊集起兄弟相率降。

translations.literal: On jimao day the brothers Yang Jiqi and others surrendered together.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Yang Jiqi and his brothers surrendered in a body.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，詔求讜言。

translations.literal: On bingchen day in the second month an edict sought forthright counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the second month he called for blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔右衛將軍元麗等討呂茍兒。

translations.literal: On wuwu day an edict ordered the Right Guard General Yuan Li and others to campaign against Lü Gouer.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he sent Right Guard General Yuan Li and others against Lü Gouer.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，以戎旅興，詔停諸作。

translations.literal: On jisi day in the third month, because the army was on campaign, an edict halted all construction.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the third month, with war abroad, he stopped every building project.

sentences.zh: 己卯，樂良王長命坐殺人，賜死。

translations.literal: On jimao day Prince of Leliang Changming was sentenced for murder and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Prince Changming of Leliang was condemned for murder and ordered to die.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，平南將軍、曲江縣公陳伯之自梁城南奔。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the General Who Pacifies the South, Duke of Qujiang Chen Bozhi, fled south from Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Chen Bozhi, General Who Pacifies the South and Duke of Qujiang, deserted from Liang to the south.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，詔罷鹽池禁。

translations.literal: On dingwei day in the fourth month of summer an edict abolished the salt-pond monopoly.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the fourth summer month he ended the salt-pond monopoly.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，詔以時澤未降，春稼已旱，或有孤老餒疾無人贍救，因以致死，暴露溝塹者，令洛陽部尉，依法棺埋。

translations.literal: On bingyin day in the fifth month an edict said: "Seasonal rains have not yet fallen and the spring crops are already drought-stricken; where the old and alone, the hungry and sick, have no one to support them and so die of want, or lie exposed in ditches and gullies, let the Luoyang district commandant bury them according to law."
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the fifth month he decreed: "Rains are late and the spring grain withers; wherever the aged alone, the sick and starving, lack care and perish in the open, the Luoyang commandant shall bury them by law."

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，元麗大破秦賊，降呂茍兒及其王公三十餘人，秦、涇二州平。

translations.literal: On gengchen day in the seventh month of autumn Yuan Li routed the Qin rebels, received the surrender of Lü Gouer and more than thirty of his dukes and kings, and Qin and Jing provinces were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the seventh autumn month Yuan Li shattered the Qin rebels, took Lü Gouer and thirty-odd kings and dukes, and pacified Qin and Jing.

sentences.zh: 戊子，中山王英大破梁徐州刺史王伯敖於陰陵。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Prince of Zhongshan Ying routed Wang Boao, Inspector of Xuzhou in Liang, at Yinling.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Prince Ying of Zhongshan crushed Wang Boao, Liang inspector of Xuzhou, at Yinling.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔發定、冀、瀛、相、並、肆六州卒十萬，以濟南軍。

translations.literal: On jichou day an edict mobilized one hundred thousand conscripts from Ding, Ji, Ying, Xiang, Bing, and Xi provinces to reinforce the army at Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he drafted a hundred thousand men from six provinces to strengthen the Jinan army.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，安東將軍邢巒破梁將桓和於孤山。

translations.literal: On renyin day the General Who Establishes the East Xing Luan defeated the Liang general Huan He at Gushan.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Xing Luan, General Who Establishes the East, beat the Liang commander Huan He at Gushan.

sentences.zh: 諸將所在克捷，兗州平。

translations.literal: The generals everywhere won; Yan Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders everywhere prevailed and Yan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，曲赦涇、秦、岐、涼、河五州。

translations.literal: On renxu day a partial amnesty was granted for Jing, Qin, Qi, Liang, and He provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he pardoned Jing, Qin, Qi, Liang, and He in part.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，邢巒大破梁軍於淮南，遂攻鐘離。

translations.literal: On guiyou day in the ninth month Xing Luan routed the Liang army south of the Huai and pressed the attack on Zhongli.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the ninth month Xing Luan smashed the Liang army south of the Huai and besieged Zhongli.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲子，帝為京兆王愉、清河王懌、廣平王懷、汝南王悅講《孝經》於式乾殿。

translations.literal: On jiazi day in the eleventh month of winter the Emperor lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety in the Hall of Form and Dryness for the Princes of Jingzhao Yu, Qinghe Yi, Guangping Huai, and Runan Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the eleventh winter month he expounded the Classic of Filial Piety in the Hall of Form and Dryness for Princes Yu, Yi, Huai, and Yue.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、蠕蠕國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Goguryeo and the Rouran both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo and the Rouran sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 四年夏四月戊戌，鐘離大水，中山王英敗績而還。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the fourth year, on wuxu day, great floods at Zhongli; Prince of Zhongshan Ying suffered defeat and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the fourth summer month of year four Zhongli flooded; Prince Ying of Zhongshan was beaten and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑朔，詔有司準前式，置國子，立太學，樹小學於四門。

translations.literal: On jichou day, the first day of the sixth month, an edict ordered the relevant offices, following the former model, to establish the Directorate of the Sons of the State, found the Imperial Academy, and plant elementary schools at the four gates.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, jichou, he ordered the offices to found the Directorate of the Sons of the State, the Imperial Academy, and elementary schools at the four gates by former precedent.

sentences.zh: 秋八月己亥，中山王英、齊王蕭寶夤坐鐘離敗，除名。

translations.literal: On jihai day in the eighth month of autumn Prince of Zhongshan Ying and Prince of Qi Xiao Baoyin were stripped of rank for the defeat at Zhongli.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the eighth autumn month Ying of Zhongshan and Baoyin of Qi were disgraced for Zhongli.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，敦煌人饑，詔開倉振恤。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the people of Dunhuang were hungry; an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou famine struck Dunhuang and the court opened the storehouses.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，詔以徙正宮極，庸績未酬，以司空、高陽王雍為太尉，尚書令、廣陽王嘉為司空，百官悉進位一級。

translations.literal: On jiwei day in the ninth month an edict said: "Having moved the capital to the pole, meritorious service has not yet been rewarded; the Minister of Works, Prince of Gaoyang Yong, is made Grand Commandant, the Director of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Guangyang Jia, Minister of Works, and all officials are advanced one rank."
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the ninth month he proclaimed: "The capital has shifted to the center yet merit goes unrewarded"; Yong of Gaoyang became Grand Commandant, Jia of Guangyang Minister of Works, and every officer rose one rank.

sentences.zh: 庚申，夏州長史曹明謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On gengshen day the chief clerk of Xia Province, Cao Ming, plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Cao Ming, chief clerk of Xia, rebelled and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 甲子，開斜谷舊道。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the old road through Xie Valley was reopened.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Xie Valley road was opened again.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，司州人饑，詔開倉振恤。

translations.literal: On bingxu day the people of Si Province were hungry; an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Si Province starved and the court opened the granaries.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲午，禁大司馬門不得車馬出入。

translations.literal: On jiawu day in the intercalary month the Great Sima Gate was forbidden to carriage and horse traffic.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the leap month he barred horses and carriages from the Great Sima Gate.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，皇后於氏崩。

translations.literal: On dingmao day in the tenth month of winter the empress, the Yu clan, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the tenth winter month Empress Yu died.

sentences.zh: 自碣石至於劍閣，東西七千里，置二十二郡尉。

translations.literal: From Jieshi to Jian Pass, seven thousand li east and west, twenty-two commandery commandants were installed.
translations.idiomatic: From Jieshi to Jian Pass, seven thousand li across, he set twenty-two commandery commandants.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西域、東夷四十餘國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year more than forty states of the Western Regions and Eastern Yi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year more than forty Western Region and Eastern Yi states sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 永平元年春三月戊子，皇子昌薨。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yongping, on wuzi day in the third month, the prince Chang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yongping year one, on wuzi day, Prince Chang died.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以去年旱儉，遣使者所在振恤。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, because of last year's drought and dearth, envoys were sent everywhere to relieve distress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, for last year's drought and famine, he sent envoys to relieve the people everywhere.

sentences.zh: 夏五月辛卯，帝以旱故，減膳徹懸。

translations.literal: On xinmao day in the fifth month of summer, because of drought the Emperor reduced his meals and removed the bells and chimes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the fifth summer month, for drought, he ate sparingly and silenced the music.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，詔依洛陽舊圖，修聽訟觀。

translations.literal: On renshen day in the sixth month an edict ordered repair of the Hall for Hearing Litigation according to the old plan of Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the sixth month he ordered the Hall for Hearing Litigation rebuilt to the old Luoyang design.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午，立夫人高氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On jiawu day in the seventh month of autumn Lady Gao was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the seventh autumn month Lady Gao was made empress.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the first day of the eighth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, renzi, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，冀州刺史、京兆王愉據州反。

translations.literal: On guihai day the Inspector of Ji, Prince of Jingzhao Yu, held the province in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Yu, Prince of Jingzhao and inspector of Ji, rebelled and held the province.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On dingmao day a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he pardoned the realm and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌，復前中山王英本封。

translations.literal: On bingxu day in the ninth month the former rank of Prince of Zhongshan Ying was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the ninth month Ying of Zhongshan was given back his former princely title.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，殺太師、彭城王勰。

translations.literal: On wuxu day the Grand Preceptor, Prince of Pengcheng Xie, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Xie, Grand Preceptor and Prince of Pengcheng, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，假鎮北將軍李平克信都，冀州平。

translations.literal: On guimao day the acting General Who Pacifies the North Li Ping captured Xindu and Ji Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Li Ping, acting General Who Pacifies the North, took Xindu and pacified Ji.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，豫州彭城人白早生殺刺史司馬悅，據城南叛。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter Bai Zaosheng of Pengcheng in Yuzhou killed the inspector Sima Yue and held the south of the city in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Bai Zaosheng of Pengcheng in Yuzhou slew Inspector Sima Yue and rebelled in the southern city.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，尚書邢巒克懸瓠，斬早生，禽梁將齊茍兒等。

translations.literal: On jiwei day in the twelfth month the Director of the Masters of Writing Xing Luan captured Xuanhu, beheaded Zaosheng, and captured the Liang generals Qi Gouer and others.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the twelfth month Xing Luan took Xuanhu, killed Zaosheng, and seized the Liang commanders Qi Gouer and others.

sentences.zh: 是歲，北狄、東夷、西域十八國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year eighteen states of the Northern Di, Eastern Yi, and Western Regions sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year eighteen Northern Di, Eastern Yi, and Western Region states sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 高昌國王曲嘉表求內徙。

translations.literal: The king of Gaochang, Qu Jia, memorialized requesting relocation within the realm.
translations.idiomatic: King Qu Jia of Gaochang asked to move his people inward.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，涇州沙門劉慧汪聚眾反，詔華州刺史奚康生討之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year the monk Liu Huiwang of Jing Province gathered a crowd in rebellion; an edict ordered the Inspector of Hua, Xi Kangsheng, to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year two the monk Liu Huiwang of Jing raised a host; the court sent Xi Kangsheng, inspector of Hua, against him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，武川鎮饑，詔開倉振恤。

translations.literal: On jiyou day in the fourth month of summer Wuchuan Garrison suffered famine; an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the fourth summer month Wuchuan starved and the court opened the storehouses.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔緣邊州鎮，自今一不聽寇盜境外，犯者罪同境內。

translations.literal: On jiazi day an edict ordered that from now on frontier provinces and garrisons must not raid beyond the border on pain of the same penalty as within the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he forbade frontier districts to plunder abroad on pain of the same penalty as at home.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，帝以旱故，減膳徹懸，禁斷屠殺。

translations.literal: On xinchou day in the fifth month, because of drought, the Emperor reduced his meals and removed the bells and chimes and forbade slaughter.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the fifth month, for drought, he ate sparingly, silenced the music, and banned killing.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸華林都亭錄囚徒，死罪以下，降一等。

translations.literal: On jiachen day he visited the Hualin Park pavilion to review prisoners; those sentenced to death and below had their punishment reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he sat in the Hualin pavilion and reviewed prisoners, lowering every sentence below death one grade.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥，詔曰：「江海方同，車書宜一，諸州軌轍，南北不等。

translations.literal: On xinhai day in the sixth month an edict said: "The rivers and seas are now one; carriage and script should be unified; the track gauges of the provinces differ between north and south.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the sixth month he proclaimed: "River and sea are one realm; carriage and script must be one; north and south still use different gauges.

sentences.zh: 今可申敕四方，遠近無二。

translations.literal: From now let a command be sent to the four quarters that near and far shall be without difference."
translations.idiomatic: Let every quarter be told that near and far shall follow a single standard."

sentences.zh: 」秋八月丙午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the first day of the eighth month of autumn, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth autumn month, bingwu, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以鄧至國世子像覽蹄為其國王。

translations.literal: On wushen day the heir of Dengzhi, Xiang Lan Ti, was enfeoffed as king of that state.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Xiang Lan Ti, heir of Dengzhi, was made king of his state.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，封故北海王子顥為北海王。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the former son of the Prince of Beihai, Hao, was enfeoffed as Prince of Beihai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Hao, son of the late Prince of Beihai, was made Prince of Beihai.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔定諸門闥名。

translations.literal: On renwu day an edict fixed the names of the various gates and doorways.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he fixed the names of the palace gates.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，以司空、廣陽王喜為司徒。

translations.literal: On guichou day in the tenth month of winter the Minister of Works, Prince of Guangyang Xi, was appointed Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the tenth winter month Xi of Guangyang became Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 庚午，郢州獻七寶床，詔不納。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Ying Province presented a bed of seven treasures; an edict ordered it not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Yingzhou sent a bed of seven treasures; he refused it.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲申，詔禁屠殺含孕，以為永制。

translations.literal: On jiashen day in the eleventh month of winter an edict forbade slaughter of pregnant creatures as a permanent statute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the eleventh winter month he banned killing the gravid as a standing law.

sentences.zh: 己丑，帝於式乾殿為諸僧、朝臣講《維摩詰經》。

translations.literal: On jichou day in the Hall of Form and Dryness the Emperor lectured on the Vimalakirti Sutra for the monks and court ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the Hall of Form and Dryness he expounded the Vimalakirti Sutra for monks and ministers.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，詔五等諸侯，其同姓者出身：公，正六下；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter an edict fixed the initial office rank for nobles of the five grades: for those of the same surname as the imperial house,
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth winter month he fixed starting ranks for the five grades of nobility: for imperial clansmen,

sentences.zh: 侯，從六上；

translations.literal: dukes entered at the lower sixth rank;
translations.idiomatic: a duke began at lower sixth rank;

sentences.zh: 伯，從六下；

translations.literal: marquises at the upper seventh from rank;
translations.idiomatic: a marquis at upper seventh from rank;

sentences.zh: 子，正七上；

translations.literal: earls at the lower seventh from rank;
translations.idiomatic: an earl at lower seventh from rank;

sentences.zh: 男，正七下。

translations.literal: viscounts at the upper seventh proper;
translations.idiomatic: a viscount at upper seventh proper;

sentences.zh: 異族出身：公，從七上；

translations.literal: barons at the lower seventh proper.
translations.idiomatic: a baron at lower seventh proper.

sentences.zh: 侯，從七下；

translations.literal: For those of a different surname: dukes at the upper seventh from rank;
translations.idiomatic: For other surnames: a duke at upper seventh from rank;

sentences.zh: 伯，正八上；

translations.literal: marquises at the lower seventh from rank;
translations.idiomatic: a marquis at lower seventh from rank;

sentences.zh: 子，正八下；

translations.literal: earls at the upper eighth proper;
translations.idiomatic: an earl at upper eighth proper;

sentences.zh: 男，從八上。

translations.literal: viscounts at the lower eighth proper;
translations.idiomatic: a viscount at lower eighth proper;

sentences.zh: 清修出身：公，從八下；

translations.literal: barons at the upper eighth from rank.
translations.idiomatic: a baron at upper eighth from rank.

sentences.zh: 侯，正九上；

translations.literal: For those of pure cultivation: dukes at the lower eighth from rank;
translations.idiomatic: For men of pure cultivation: a duke at lower eighth from rank;

sentences.zh: 伯，正九下；

translations.literal: earls at the lower ninth proper;
translations.idiomatic: an earl at lower ninth proper;

sentences.zh: 子，從九上；

translations.literal: viscounts at the upper ninth from rank;
translations.idiomatic: a viscount at upper ninth from rank;

sentences.zh: 男，從九下。

translations.literal: barons at the lower ninth from rank.
translations.idiomatic: a baron at lower ninth from rank.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西域、東夷二十四國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year twenty-four states of the Western Regions and Eastern Yi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year twenty-four Western Region and Eastern Yi states sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 延昌元年春正月乙巳，以頻年水旱，百姓饑弊，分遣使者，開倉振恤。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yanxi, on yisi day, because of successive years of flood and drought and the people's hunger and distress, envoys were sent in separate parties to open the granaries and relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yanxi year one, on yisi, after years of flood and drought he sent envoys to open storehouses and succor the hungry.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以尚書令高肇為司徒，清河王懌為司空。

translations.literal: On bingchen day the Director of the Masters of Writing Gao Zhao was made Minister of Education and Prince of Qinghe Yi Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Gao Zhao became Minister of Education and Yi of Qinghe Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，州郡十一大水，詔開倉振恤。

translations.literal: On jiawu day in the third month eleven provinces and commanderies suffered great flood; an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the third month flood struck eleven provinces and commanderies and the court opened the granaries.

sentences.zh: 以京師谷貴，出倉粟八十萬石以振恤貧者。

translations.literal: Because grain in the capital was dear, eight hundred thousand piculs from the storehouses were issued to relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: With grain dear in the capital he released eight hundred thousand piculs for the poor.

sentences.zh: 己未，安樂王詮薨。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Prince of Anle Quan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Quan, Prince of Anle, died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，詔以旱故，斷食粟之畜。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, because of drought, an edict forbade feeding grain to livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, for drought, he forbade feeding grain to livestock.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔曰：「遷京嵩縣，年將二紀，博士端然虛祿。

translations.literal: On dingmao day an edict said: "Since the move to Song County nearly twenty years have passed, yet the Erudites stand idle on empty stipends.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he proclaimed: "Nearly twenty years since we moved to Song County, yet the Erudites draw pay without teaching.

sentences.zh: 靖言念之，有兼愧慨。

translations.literal: Reflecting on this, I feel shame and distress.
translations.idiomatic: The thought shames me.

sentences.zh: 可嚴敕有司，國子學，孟冬使成。

translations.literal: Let the relevant offices be strictly charged: the Directorate of the Sons of the State shall be completed by mid-winter.
translations.idiomatic: Let the offices be charged to finish the Directorate by mid-winter,

sentences.zh: 太學、四門，明年暮春令就。

translations.literal: the Imperial Academy and the four gates shall be ready by late spring of next year."
translations.idiomatic: the Academy and the four gate schools by late spring next year."

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，以旱故，詔尚書與群司鞫理獄訟。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, because of drought, an edict ordered the Director of the Masters of Writing and the various offices to examine and judge lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, for drought, he ordered the secretariat and every office to review lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔饑人就谷六鎮。

translations.literal: On xinwei day an edict allowed the hungry to go to the six garrisons for grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he let the hungry seek grain at the six garrisons.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，帝以旱故，減膳徹懸。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, because of drought, the Emperor reduced his meals and removed the bells and chimes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, for drought, he ate sparingly and silenced the music.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔曰：「肆州地震陷裂，死傷甚多。

translations.literal: On guiwei day an edict said: "In Sizhou an earthquake opened fissures and many were killed and wounded.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he proclaimed: "Sizhou has split in an earthquake and many lie dead or hurt.

sentences.zh: 亡者不可復追，生病宜加療救。

translations.literal: The dead cannot be brought back, but the living should receive added medical care.
translations.idiomatic: The dead cannot return, but the living must be healed.

sentences.zh: 可遣太醫、折傷醫並給所須藥就療。

translations.literal: Let the Chief Physician and the bone-setting physicians be sent with the needed medicines to treat them."
translations.idiomatic: Send the Chief Physician and bone-setters with medicines to treat them."

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On yiyou day a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he pardoned the realm and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 詔立理訴殿、申訟車，以盡冤窮之理。

translations.literal: An edict established the Hall for Settling Grievances and the carriage for presenting suits, to exhaust the principle of redressing the wronged.
translations.idiomatic: He founded the Hall for Settling Grievances and the carriage for presenting suits to reach every wrong.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，詔天下有粟之家，供年之外，悉貸饑人。

translations.literal: On bingwu day in the fifth month an edict ordered that throughout the realm households with grain, beyond what was needed for the year, should lend all the rest to the hungry.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the fifth month he ordered every household with surplus grain to lend it to the hungry.

sentences.zh: 自二月不雨至於是月。

translations.literal: From the second month no rain had fallen until this month.
translations.idiomatic: No rain had fallen since the second month.

sentences.zh: 己未晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, the last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the month, jiwei, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，澍雨大洽。

translations.literal: On renshen day timely rain fell in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the long-awaited rain came in torrents.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，通河南牝馬之禁。

translations.literal: On wuyin day the prohibition on breeding mares south of the Yellow River was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he lifted the ban on breeding mares south of the river.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔出太倉粟五十萬石，以振京師及州郡饑人。

translations.literal: On gengchen day an edict ordered five hundred thousand piculs from the Grand Storehouse issued to relieve the hungry in the capital and the provinces and commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he released five hundred thousand piculs from the Grand Storehouse for the capital and the provinces.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，立皇子詡為皇太子。

translations.literal: On yihai day in the tenth month of winter the prince Xu was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the tenth winter month Prince Xu was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，詔以東宮建，賜天下為父後者爵一級。

translations.literal: On bingshen day in the eleventh month an edict ordered that, because the Eastern Palace was established, every man who was his father's sole heir should receive one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the eleventh month, for the crown prince's installation, every sole heir received one noble rank.

sentences.zh: 孝子順孫廉夫節婦旌表門閭，量給粟帛。

translations.literal: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, honest husbands, and chaste wives were to have their gates marked with honor and grain and cloth given in measure.
translations.idiomatic: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, honest men, and chaste women had their gates honored and grain and cloth bestowed.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳，詔守宰為御史彈赦免者，及考在中第，皆代之。

translations.literal: On jisi day in the twelfth month an edict ordered that magistrates dismissed on impeachment by the censor and those whose assessment fell in the middle rank should all be replaced.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the twelfth month he ordered every magistrate impeached by the censor or graded in the middle rank replaced.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西域、東夷十國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year ten states of the Western Regions and Eastern Yi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year ten Western Region and Eastern Yi states sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月戊戌，帝御申訟車，親理冤訟。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, on wuxu day, the Emperor mounted the carriage for presenting suits and personally judged wrongful lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year two, on wuxu, he rode the suit carriage and judged wrongs himself.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰朔，振恤京師貧人。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the first day of the second month, the poor of the capital were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, bingchen, the capital poor were relieved.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以六鎮大饑，開倉拯贍。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, because the six garrisons suffered great famine, the granaries were opened to save and sustain them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, with the six garrisons starving, he opened the granaries to sustain them.

sentences.zh: 己卯，進太尉、高陽王雍位太保。

translations.literal: On jimao day Grand Commandant Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, was advanced to Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Yong of Gaoyang was promoted to Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛丑，以苑牧地賜代遷人無田者。

translations.literal: On xinchou day in the intercalary month the park herds' lands were granted to migrants from Dai without fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the leap month, on xinchou, park land went to Dai migrants without fields.

sentences.zh: 是春，人饑，死者數萬口。

translations.literal: That spring people starved; tens of thousands died.
translations.idiomatic: That spring famine killed tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，以絹十五萬疋振河南郡人。

translations.literal: On gengzi day in the fourth month of summer one hundred fifty thousand bolts of silk were issued to relieve the people of Henan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the fourth summer month he gave a hundred fifty thousand bolts of silk to Henan.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, the first day of the fifth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, jiayin, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 是月，壽春大水。

translations.literal: That month great floods struck Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shouchun flooded.

sentences.zh: 遣平東將軍奚康生等步騎數千赴之。

translations.literal: The General Who Pacifies the East Xi Kangsheng and others with several thousand foot and horse were sent to the scene.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Xi Kangsheng, General Who Pacifies the East, with thousands of horse and foot to the scene.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，青州人饑，詔使者開倉振恤。

translations.literal: On yiyou day in the sixth month the people of Qing Province were hungry; an edict ordered envoys to open the granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the sixth month Qing starved and envoys opened the storehouses.

sentences.zh: 甲午，曲赦揚州。

translations.literal: On jiawu day a partial amnesty was granted for Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he pardoned Yang in part.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，帝御申訟車，親理冤訟。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the Emperor mounted the carriage for presenting suits and personally judged wrongful lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he rode the suit carriage and judged wrongs himself.

sentences.zh: 是夏，十三郡大水。

translations.literal: That summer thirteen commanderies suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: That summer flood struck thirteen commanderies.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛卯，詔以水旱饑儉，百姓多陷罪辜，降死以下刑。

translations.literal: On xinmao day in the eighth month of autumn an edict ordered that, because of flood, drought, famine, and dearth, and because many common people had fallen into crime, punishments below death were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the eighth autumn month, for flood, drought, and famine, he lowered every sentence below death.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，以貴族豪門，崇習奢侈，詔尚書嚴立限級，節其流宕。

translations.literal: On bingchen day in the ninth month, because the noble and powerful clans were addicted to luxury, an edict ordered the Director of the Masters of Writing to set strict limits and curb excess.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the ninth month he charged the secretariat to curb the luxury of great houses.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，詔以恒、肆地震，人多死傷，重丐一年租賦。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter an edict ordered that, because of the earthquakes at Heng and Xi and the many dead and wounded, the land tax and levies were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, for the Heng and Xi earthquakes, he remitted a year of tax.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，丐洛陽、河陰二縣租賦。

translations.literal: On bingxu day in the twelfth month the land tax of Luoyang and Heyin counties was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he remitted the land tax of Luoyang and Heyin.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔以恒、肆地震，人多離災，其有課丁沒盡，老幼單立，家無受復者，各賜廩粟，以接來稔。

translations.literal: On yisi day an edict ordered that, because of the earthquakes at Heng and Xi and the many separated by disaster, where corvée households were entirely lost and only the old and young remained alone with no one to receive exemption, each should be given relief grain to carry them to the next harvest.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, for the Heng and Xi earthquakes, households stripped of corvée men received relief grain until the next harvest.

sentences.zh: 是歲，東夷、西域十餘國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year more than ten states of the Eastern Yi and Western Regions sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year more than ten Eastern Yi and Western Region states sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月乙未，詔曰：「肆州秀容郡敷城縣、雁門郡原平縣並自去年四月以來，山鳴地震，於今不已。

translations.literal: On yimao day in the second month of the third year an edict said: "In Fucheng County of Xiurong Commandery in Sizhou and Yuanping County in Yanmen Commandery, since the fourth month of last year mountains have thundered and the earth has quaked without cease until now.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the second month of year three he proclaimed: "In Fucheng of Xiurong and Yuanping of Yanmen mountains have thundered and the earth shaken since last fourth month without cease.

sentences.zh: 告譴彰咎，朕甚懼焉。

translations.literal: Heaven's reproof and the manifestation of guilt fill me with fear.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's warning fills me with fear.

sentences.zh: 可恤瘼寬刑，以答災譴。

translations.literal: Let distress be relieved and punishments lightened to answer the calamity."
translations.idiomatic: Let distress be eased and punishments lightened to answer the omen."

sentences.zh: 」夏四月，青州人饑。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer the people of Qing Province were hungry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Qing starved.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，開倉振恤。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the storehouses were opened.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上御申訟車，親理冤訟。

translations.literal: On yisi day the Emperor mounted the carriage for presenting suits and personally judged wrongful lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he rode the suit carriage and judged wrongs himself.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲申，帝臨朝堂，考百司而加黜陟。

translations.literal: On jiashen day in the eighth month of autumn the Emperor attended court in the Hall of Audience, examined the hundred offices, and made dismissals and promotions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the eighth autumn month he sat in the Hall of Audience, judged the hundred offices, and promoted and demoted.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛亥，詔司徒高肇為大將軍、平蜀大都督，步騎十五萬，西伐益州。

translations.literal: On xinhai day in the eleventh month of winter an edict made Minister of Education Gao Zhao Grand General and Grand Commander for Pacifying Shu, with one hundred fifty thousand foot and horse to campaign west against Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the eleventh winter month he made Gao Zhao Grand General and commander of a hundred fifty thousand men to invade Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，幽州沙門劉僧紹聚眾反，自號凈居國明法王。

translations.literal: On dingsi day the monk Liu Sengshao of Youzhou gathered a crowd in rebellion and styled himself King Mingfa of the Pure Dwelling State.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the monk Liu Sengshao of Youzhou rebelled as King Mingfa of the Pure Dwelling State.

sentences.zh: 州郡捕斬之。

translations.literal: The province and commandery captured and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: The province seized and executed him.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，詔立明堂。

translations.literal: On gengyin day in the twelfth month an edict ordered the Bright Hall established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the twelfth month he ordered the Bright Hall built.

sentences.zh: 是歲，東夷、西域八國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year eight states of the Eastern Yi and Western Regions sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year eight Eastern Yi and Western Region states sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月甲寅，帝不豫。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, on jiayin day, the Emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year four, on jiayin day, the Emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，崩於式乾殿，時年三十三。

translations.literal: On dingsi day he died in the Hall of Form and Dryness at the age of thirty-three.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he died in the Hall of Form and Dryness, aged thirty-three.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌朔，上尊謚曰宣武皇帝，廟號世宗。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, the first day of the second month, the posthumous title Emperor Xuanwu was granted and the temple name Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, jiaxu, he received the posthumous title Emperor Xuanwu and the temple name Shizong.

sentences.zh: 甲午，葬景陵。

translations.literal: On jiawu day he was buried at Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he was buried at Jingling.

sentences.zh: 帝幼有大度，喜怒不形於色，雅性儉素。

translations.literal: The Emperor from youth had great magnanimity; joy and anger did not show on his face, and his nature was elegantly simple.
translations.idiomatic: From boyhood he was large-minded; pleasure and anger never showed on his face, and he loved plain living.

sentences.zh: 初，孝文欲觀諸子誌尚，大陳寶物，任其所取。

translations.literal: At first Emperor Xiaowen wished to observe the aims of his sons; he displayed great treasures and let each take what he would.
translations.idiomatic: Once Xiaowen spread out treasures to see what his sons would choose.

sentences.zh: 京兆王愉等皆競取珍玩，帝唯取骨如意而已。

translations.literal: The Princes of Jingzhao Yu and the others all competed for jewels and curios; the Emperor alone took a bone ruyi.
translations.idiomatic: Yu of Jingzhao and the rest seized gems and curios; he alone took a bone ruyi.

sentences.zh: 孝文大奇之。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowen marveled greatly at this.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaowen was deeply struck.

sentences.zh: 及庶人恂失德，孝文謂彭城王勰曰：「吾國疑此兒有非常誌相，今果然矣！

translations.literal: When the commoner Xun lost virtue, Emperor Xiaowen said to Prince of Pengcheng Xie: "I suspected this boy had an extraordinary destiny; now it has indeed come to pass!
translations.idiomatic: When the heir Xun fell, Xiaowen told Xie of Pengcheng: "I feared this son carried an uncommon fate; now it has proved true!

sentences.zh: 」乃見立為儲貳。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he was seen and installed as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: " Then he was named crown prince.

sentences.zh: 雅愛經史，尤長釋氏之義，每至講論，連夜忘疲。

translations.literal: He loved the classics and histories, and was especially skilled in Buddhist doctrine; whenever he reached disputation, he forgot fatigue through the night.
translations.idiomatic: He loved the classics and excelled in Buddhist teaching, debating through the night without tiring.

sentences.zh: 善風儀，美容貌，臨朝深默，端嚴若神，有人君之量矣。

translations.literal: He was skilled in bearing and ceremony, with a beautiful countenance; at court he was deeply silent, stern and grave as a spirit, and had the measure of a ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Graceful in bearing, handsome in face, he sat at court in deep silence, stern as a god, with a true king's presence.

sentences.zh: 肅宗孝明帝

translations.literal: Emperor Suzong Xiaoming.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Suzong Xiaoming.

sentences.zh: 肅宗孝明皇帝諱詡，宣武皇帝之第二子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Suzong Xiaoming, taboo name Xu, was the second son of Emperor Xuanwu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaoming the Filial and Bright, taboo name Xu, was Xuanwu's second son.

sentences.zh: 母曰胡充華。

translations.literal: His mother was Hu Chonghua.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Hu Chonghua.

sentences.zh: 永平三年三月丙戌，生於宣光殿之東北，有光照於庭中。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Yongping, on bingxu day, he was born in the northeast of the Xuanguang Hall; light filled the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the third month of Yongping year three he was born in the northeast of Xuanguang Hall, and light filled the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 延昌元年十月乙亥，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Yanxi, on yihai day, he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the tenth month of Yanxi year one he was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 四年正月丁巳，宣武帝崩。

translations.literal: On dingsi day in the first month of the fourth year Emperor Xuanwu died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the first month of year four Xuanwu died.

sentences.zh: 是夜，太子即皇帝位。

translations.literal: That night the crown prince took the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: That night the heir ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大赦。

translations.literal: On wuwu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he pardoned the realm.

sentences.zh: 己未，征下西討東防諸軍。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the armies for the western campaign and eastern defense were mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he mobilized the western and eastern armies.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔太保、高陽王雍入居西栢堂決庶政，以任城王澄為尚書令，百官總己以聽二王。

translations.literal: On gengshen day an edict ordered Grand Tutor Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, to enter the Western Cypress Hall to decide ordinary government, Prince of Rencheng Cheng to be Director of the Masters of Writing, and all officials to defer to the two princes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he put Grand Tutor Yong of Gaoyang in the Western Cypress Hall to govern, made Cheng of Rencheng Director of the Masters of Writing, and ordered all officers to obey the two princes.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，尊皇后高氏為皇太后。

translations.literal: On gengchen day in the second month Empress Gao was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the second month Empress Gao became empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，司徒高肇至京師，以罪賜死。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Minister of Education Gao Zhao reached the capital and was sentenced for crime and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Gao Zhao reached the capital, was condemned, and ordered to die.

sentences.zh: 癸未，進太保、高陽王雍位太傅，領太尉。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Grand Tutor Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, was advanced to Grand Preceptor and Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Yong of Gaoyang was promoted to Grand Preceptor and Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 以司空、清河王懌為司徒，以驃騎大將軍、廣平王懷為司空。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Yi, Prince of Qinghe, was made Minister of Education; Rapid Cavalry General Huai, Prince of Guangping, Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Yi of Qinghe became Minister of Education and Huai of Guangping Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，尊胡充華為皇太妃。

translations.literal: On yihai day Hu Chonghua was honored as grand imperial consort.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Hu Chonghua was made grand imperial consort.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰朔，皇太后出俗為尼，徙禦金墉城。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the first day of the third month, the empress dowager left the world and became a nun, moving her residence to the Jinyong city.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, jiachen, the empress dowager took the tonsure and moved to Jinyong.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔進宮臣位一級。

translations.literal: On bingchen day an edict advanced palace officials one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he raised palace officers one rank.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，進文武群官位一級。

translations.literal: On yichou day civil and military officials were advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he raised civil and military officers one rank.

sentences.zh: 夏六月，沙門法慶聚眾反於冀州，殺阜城令，自稱大乘。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer the monk Fajing gathered a crowd in rebellion in Ji Province, killed the magistrate of Fucheng, and styled himself Mahayana.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth summer month the monk Fajing rebelled in Ji, killed the magistrate of Fucheng, and called himself Mahayana.

sentences.zh: 秋八月乙亥，領軍於忠矯詔殺左僕射郭祚、尚書裴植，免太傅、高陽王雍官，以王還第。

translations.literal: On yihai day in the eighth month of autumn the army commander Yu Zhong forged an edict and killed the Left Vice Minister Guo Zuo and the Director of the Masters of Writing Pei Zhi, removed Grand Preceptor Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, from office, and sent the prince home.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the eighth autumn month Yu Zhong forged an edict, killed Guo Zuo and Pei Zhi, and stripped Yong of Gaoyang of office.

sentences.zh: 丙子，尊皇太妃為皇太后。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the grand imperial consort was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the grand imperial consort became empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 戊子，帝朝太后於宣光殿。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the Emperor attended the empress dowager at the Xuanguang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the emperor visited the empress dowager at Xuanguang Hall.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: He pardoned the realm.

sentences.zh: 己丑，進司徒、清河王懌為太傅，領太尉。

translations.literal: On jichou day Minister of Education Yi, Prince of Qinghe, was advanced to Grand Tutor and Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Yi of Qinghe was made Grand Tutor and Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 以司空、廣平王懷為太保，領司徒。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Huai, Prince of Guangping, was made Grand Tutor and Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Huai of Guangping became Grand Tutor and Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 任城王澄為司空。

translations.literal: Prince of Rencheng Cheng was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng of Rencheng became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以車騎大將軍於忠為尚書令，特進崔光為車騎大將軍，並儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Rapid Cavalry General Yu Zhong was made Director of the Masters of Writing and Special Advanced Cui Guang Rapid Cavalry General, both with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Yu Zhong became Director of the Masters of Writing and Cui Guang Rapid Cavalry General, each with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，復江陽王繼本國，復濟南王彧先封為臨淮王。

translations.literal: On renchen day Prince of Jiangyang Ji's original state was restored, and Prince of Jinan Yu's former enfeoffment was restored as Prince of Linhuai.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Ji of Jiangyang received his state again and Yu of Jinan was restored as Prince of Linhuai.

sentences.zh: 群臣奏請皇太后臨朝稱制。

translations.literal: The ministers memorialized requesting that the empress dowager hold court and rule.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers asked the empress dowager to rule from court.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，皇太后親覽萬機。

translations.literal: On yisi day in the ninth month the empress dowager personally oversaw all affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the ninth month the empress dowager took power.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，征西大將軍元遙破斬法慶，傳首京師。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the General Who Conquers the West Yuan Yao routed and beheaded Fajing and sent his head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Yuan Yao, General Who Conquers the West, killed Fajing and sent his head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 安定王燮薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Anding Xie died.
translations.idiomatic: Xie, Prince of Anding, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月辛丑，以高陽王雍為太師。

translations.literal: On xinchou day in the twelfth month of winter Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the twelfth winter month Yong of Gaoyang became Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 己酉，鎮南將軍崔亮破梁將趙祖悅軍，遂圍硤石。

translations.literal: On jiyou day the General Who Guards the South Cui Liang routed the army of the Liang general Zhao Zuyue and then besieged Xiashi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Cui Liang, General Who Guards the South, routed Zhao Zuyue of Liang and besieged Xiashi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，帝、皇太后謁景陵。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the Emperor and empress dowager visited Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor and empress dowager visited Jingling.

sentences.zh: 是歲，東夷、西域、北狄十八國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year eighteen states of the Eastern Yi, Western Regions, and Northern Di sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year eighteen Eastern Yi, Western Region, and Northern Di states sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 熙平元年春正月戊辰朔，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the first day of the first month of the first year of Xiping, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of Xiping year one, wuchen, he pardoned the realm and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 荊沔都督元誌大破梁軍。

translations.literal: Yuan Zhi, area commander of Jing and Mian, routed the Liang army.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zhi, commander of Jing and Mian, crushed the Liang army.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書李平為行臺，節度討硤石諸軍。

translations.literal: The Director of the Ministry of Personnel Li Ping was made acting commander of the armies campaigning against Xiashi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ping, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made acting commander against Xiashi.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，鎮東將軍蕭寶夤大破梁將於淮北。

translations.literal: On yisi day in the second month the General Who Establishes the East Xiao Baoyin routed the Liang generals north of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the second month Baoyin of Qi, General Who Establishes the East, routed the Liang generals north of the Huai.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，初聽秀才對策，第中上已上敘之。

translations.literal: On guihai day for the first time licentiates were examined in policy essays; those in the upper middle rank and above were given office.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai licentiates were first examined in policy; those graded upper middle and above received office.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，鎮南崔亮、鎮軍李平等克硤石，斬趙祖悅，傳首京師，盡俘其眾。

translations.literal: On yichou day Cui Liang, General Who Guards the Army, and Li Ping and others captured Xiashi, beheaded Zhao Zuyue, sent his head to the capital, and took all his troops captive.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Cui Liang and Li Ping took Xiashi, killed Zhao Zuyue, sent his head to the capital, and captured his host.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the first day of the third month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, wuchen, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，以瀛州人饑，開倉振恤。

translations.literal: On wuxu day in the fourth month of summer, because the people of Ying Province were hungry, the granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the fourth summer month, with Ying starving, the court opened the storehouses.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯朔，以炎旱，命厘察獄訟，權停作役。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the first day of the fifth month, because of heat and drought, an edict ordered examination of prison cases and temporary halt of corvée projects.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, dingmao, for heat and drought he ordered prisons reviewed and corvée halted.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔放華林野獸於山澤。

translations.literal: On gengwu day an edict released the wild beasts of Hualin Park into mountains and marshes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he released the wild beasts of Hualin Park to mountain and marsh.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，重申殺牛禁。

translations.literal: On gengwu day in the seventh month of autumn the prohibition on killing cattle was reaffirmed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the seventh autumn month he reaffirmed the ban on killing cattle.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，詔古帝諸陵四面各五十步，勿聽耕稼。

translations.literal: On bingwu day an edict ordered that within fifty paces on every side of the tombs of ancient emperors, plowing and sowing were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he forbade cultivation within fifty paces of ancient imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，淮堰破，梁緣淮城戍村落十餘萬口，皆漂入海。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the Huai embankment broke; more than one hundred thousand households in Liang garrisons and villages along the Huai were swept into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the Huai dike broke and more than a hundred thousand Liang households along the river were swept to sea.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐谷渾、宕昌、鄧至、高昌、陰平等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Tuyuhun, Dangchang, Dengzhi, Gaochang, Yinping, and other states sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tuyuhun, Dangchang, Dengzhi, Gaochang, Yinping, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，大乘余賊，復相聚攻瀛州，刺史宇文福討平之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, remnant Mahayana bandits gathered again and attacked Ying Province; the inspector Yuwen Fu suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year two Mahayana remnants attacked Ying; Inspector Yuwen Fu put them down.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大赦。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he pardoned the realm.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔遣大使巡行四方，問疾苦，恤孤寡，黜陟幽明。

translations.literal: On gengyin day an edict dispatched great envoys to tour the four quarters, inquire into hardship, succor the orphaned and widowed, and dismiss the obscure and promote the clear.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he sent great envoys to tour the realm, hear hardship, succor orphans and widows, and judge the magistrates.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，封御史中尉元匡為東平王。

translations.literal: On dingwei day in the second month the Imperial Censor Yuan Kuang was enfeoffed as Prince of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the second month Yuan Kuang, Imperial Censor, was made Prince of Dongping.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，太保、領司徒、廣平王懷薨。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Grand Tutor Huai, Prince of Guangping, who held the post of Minister of Education, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Huai of Guangping, Grand Tutor and Minister of Education, died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，詔京尹所統年高者，板賜郡各有差。

translations.literal: On dingyou day in the fourth month of summer an edict ordered that the elderly in the capital magistrate's jurisdiction receive nominal appointment to commanderies, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the fourth summer month he granted nominal commandery posts to the aged of the capital, by rank.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以開府儀同三司胡國珍為司徒。

translations.literal: On wushen day Hu Guozhen, Privy Treasurer with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies, was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Hu Guozhen, Privy Treasurer with Three Excellencies privilege, became Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，皇太后幸伊闕石窟寺，即日還宮。

translations.literal: On yimao day the empress dowager visited the Yique cave temple and returned to the palace the same day.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the empress dowager visited the Yique cave temple and returned the same day.

sentences.zh: 改封安定王超為北平王。

translations.literal: Prince of Anding Chao was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Chao of Anding was made Prince of Beiping.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，重申天文禁，犯者以大辟論。

translations.literal: On gengchen day in the fifth month the prohibition on astronomical divination was reaffirmed; violators were judged by the great capital statute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the fifth month he reaffirmed the ban on astronomy; violators faced the death penalty.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，儀同三司、汝南王悅坐殺人免官，以王還第。

translations.literal: On yihai day in the seventh month of autumn Yu, Prince of Runan, with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies, was sentenced for murder, removed from office, and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the seventh autumn month Yu of Runan was condemned for murder, stripped of office, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 己巳，享太廟。

translations.literal: On jisi day he offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he sacrificed at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，宴道武以來宗室年十五以上於顯陽殿，申家人禮。

translations.literal: On wuxu day in the eighth month he feasted imperial clansmen from Emperor Daowu onward who were fifteen or older in the Xuanyang Hall and observed the rites of the family.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the eighth month he feasted imperial clansmen fifteen and older from Daowu onward in Xuanyang Hall as kin.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔庶族子弟年未十五，不聽入仕。

translations.literal: On jihai day an edict ordered that commoners' sons not yet fifteen were not permitted to enter office.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he forbade commoners' sons under fifteen to take office.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔咸陽、京兆二王子女，還附屬籍。

translations.literal: On gengzi day an edict ordered that the children of the Princes of Xianyang and Jingzhao be returned to their attached registers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he returned the children of the princes of Xianyang and Jingzhao to their registers.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔太師、高陽王雍入居門下，參決尚書奏事。

translations.literal: On dingwei day an edict ordered Grand Preceptor Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, to enter the Gate Department and join in deciding memorials to the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he ordered Grand Preceptor Yong of Gaoyang into the Gate Department to decide secretariat memorials.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，以幽、冀、滄、瀛、光五州饑，遣使巡撫，開倉振恤。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, because You, Ji, Cang, Ying, and Guang provinces suffered famine, envoys were sent to tour and relieve them and the granaries were opened.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, with five provinces starving, he sent envoys to tour and open the storehouses.

sentences.zh: 是歲，東夷、西域、氐、羌等十一國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year eleven states of the Eastern Yi, Western Regions, Di, and Qiang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year eleven Eastern Yi, Western Region, Di, and Qiang states sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 神龜元年春正月甲子，詔以氐酋楊定為陰平王。

translations.literal: On jiazi day in the first month of the first year of Shengui an edict made the Di chieftain Yang Ding King of Yinping.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the first month of Shengui year one he made the Di chieftain Yang Ding King of Yinping.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔給京畿及諸州老人板郡縣各有差，及賜鰥寡孤獨粟帛。

translations.literal: On renshen day an edict granted the elderly of the capital region and the provinces nominal appointment to commanderies and counties, each according to rank, and gave grain and cloth to widowers, orphans, and the solitary.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he granted nominal posts to the aged of the capital and provinces and gave grain and cloth to widowers, orphans, and the alone.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔以雜役戶或冒入清流，所在職人，皆令五人相保。

translations.literal: On gengchen day an edict ordered that where corvée households had falsely entered the pure stream, local officials were to have every five men guarantee one another.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he ordered every five local officials to guarantee one another against corvée men entering the pure stream.

sentences.zh: 無人任保者，奪官還役。

translations.literal: Those with no one to stand surety for them were stripped of office and returned to corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Men without guarantors lost office and returned to corvée.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，秦州羌反。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the Qiang of Qin Province rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Qiang of Qin rebelled.

sentences.zh: 幽州大饑，死者三千七百九十人。

translations.literal: In You Province great famine killed three thousand seven hundred ninety people.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in You killed three thousand seven hundred ninety people.

sentences.zh: 詔刺史開倉振恤。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the inspector to open the granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The inspector opened the storehouses.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，詔以神龜表瑞，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On jiyou day in the second month an edict ordered that, because the divine tortoise had appeared as an omen, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the second month, for the tortoise omen, he pardoned the realm and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 東益州氐反。

translations.literal: The Di of Eastern Yizhou rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The Di of Eastern Yizhou rose.

sentences.zh: 三月，南秦州氐反。

translations.literal: In the third month the Di of Southern Qin Province rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Di of Southern Qin rose.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，司徒胡國珍薨。

translations.literal: On dingyou day in the fourth month of summer Minister of Education Hu Guozhen died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the fourth summer month Hu Guozhen died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，改封江陽王繼為京兆王。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Prince of Jiangyang Ji was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Ji of Jiangyang was made Prince of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 六月，自正月不雨，是月辛卯，澍雨乃降。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, from the first month no rain had fallen; on xinmao day of this month timely rain descended.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, with no rain since the first month, timely rain fell on xinmao.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，河州人卻鐵匆聚眾反，自稱水池王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn the people of Hezhou, Que Tiecang, gathered a crowd in rebellion and styled himself King of the Water Pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Que Tiecang of Hezhou rebelled as King of the Water Pool.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲辰，開恒州銀山禁。

translations.literal: On jiachen day in the intercalary month the prohibition on Yinshan silver mines in Heng Province was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In the leap month, on jiachen, he lifted the ban on Yinshan silver in Heng.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑朔，詔京師見囚殊死以下，悉減一等。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the first day of the eighth month, an edict ordered that prisoners in the capital facing death and below all had their punishment reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, guichou, he lowered every capital sentence below death one grade.

sentences.zh: 甲子，卻鐵匆詣行臺源子恭降。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Que Tiecang came to the acting commander Yuan Zigong and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Que Tiecang surrendered to Yuan Zigong, acting commander.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，皇太后高氏崩於瑤光寺。

translations.literal: On wushen day in the ninth month Empress Dowager Gao died at the Yaoguang Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the ninth month Empress Dowager Gao died at Yaoguang Temple.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，以尼禮葬高太后於芒山。
