translations.literal: On dingmao day in the tenth month of winter she was buried on Mang Mountain with the rites for a nun.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the tenth winter month she was buried on Mang Mountain with a nun's rites.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，詔曰：「人生有終，下歸兆域。

translations.literal: On xinwei day in the twelfth month an edict said: "Human life has an end and all return to the burial ground.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the twelfth month he proclaimed: "Life ends and all return to the grave.

sentences.zh: 京邑隱振，口盈億萬，貴賤攸憑，未有定所。

translations.literal: In the capital hidden grief stirs; mouths number in the hundreds of millions; noble and base alike depend on this, yet there is no fixed place."
translations.idiomatic: The capital mourns in silence; mouths beyond counting, high and low alike, still lack a fixed resting place."

sentences.zh: 今制幹脯山以西，擬為九原。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that west of Ganpo Mountain be designated as Jiuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He designated the land west of Ganpo Mountain as Jiuyuan.

sentences.zh: 」是歲，東夷、西域、北狄十一國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year eleven states of the Eastern Yi, Western Regions, and Northern Di sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year eleven Eastern Yi, Western Region, and Northern Di states sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, the first day of the first month of the second year, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second year, xinsi, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：「皇太后捴挹自居，稱號弗備。

translations.literal: On dinghai day an edict said: "The empress dowager restrained herself in dwelling alone and her title was not complete.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he proclaimed: "The empress dowager lived in restraint and her title was incomplete.

sentences.zh: 正光元年春正月乙亥朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On yihai day, the first day of the first month of the first year of Zhengguang, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of Zhengguang year one, yihai, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，詔尚書長孫承業巡撫北蕃，觀察風俗。

translations.literal: On bingchen day in the fourth month of summer an edict ordered the Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Chengye to tour the northern frontier and observe customs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the fourth summer month he sent Yuan Chengye, Director of the Masters of Writing, to tour the northern marches.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，以炎旱故，詔八坐鞫見囚，申枉濫。

translations.literal: On xinsi day in the fifth month, because of heat and drought, an edict ordered the Eight Ministers to examine prisoners and redress wrongful punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the fifth month, for heat and drought, he ordered the Eight Ministers to review prisons and right wrongs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，侍中元叉、中常侍劉騰奉帝幸前殿，矯皇太后詔，歸政遜位。

translations.literal: On bingzi day in the seventh month of autumn the Attendant Yuan Cha and the Palace Attendant Liu Teng, supporting the Emperor, went to the front hall; they forged an edict of the empress dowager returning government and yielding the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the seventh autumn month Yuan Cha and Liu Teng took the emperor to the front hall and forged an edict returning rule to him.

sentences.zh: 乃幽皇太后北宮，殺太傅、清河王懌，總勒禁旅，決事殿中。

translations.literal: Thereupon they imprisoned the empress dowager in the Northern Palace, killed Grand Tutor Yi, Prince of Qinghe, took overall command of the guard, and decided affairs in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: They locked the empress dowager in the Northern Palace, killed Yi of Qinghe, seized the guards, and ruled from the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，帝加元服，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On xinmao day the Emperor assumed the cap of manhood; a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he came of age, pardoned the realm, and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 內外百官進位一等。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials within and without were advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Every civil and military officer rose one rank.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，相州刺史、中山王熙舉兵欲誅騰。

translations.literal: On jiayin day in the eighth month the Inspector of Xiang, Prince of Zhongshan Xi, raised troops intending to kill Teng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the eighth month Xi of Zhongshan, inspector of Xiang, raised troops to kill Teng.

sentences.zh: 不果，見殺。

translations.literal: He did not succeed and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: He failed and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，蠕蠕主阿那瑰來奔。

translations.literal: On renchen day in the ninth month the Rouran ruler Anagui came in flight.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the ninth month the Rouran ruler Anagui fled to the court.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以太師、高陽王雍為丞相。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Grand Preceptor Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, was made Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Yong of Gaoyang became Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，以儀同三司、汝南王悅為太尉。

translations.literal: On yihai day in the tenth month of winter Yu, Prince of Runan, with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies, was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the tenth winter month Yu of Runan became Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，封阿那瑰為朔方郡公、蠕蠕王。

translations.literal: On jihai day in the eleventh month Anagui was enfeoffed as Duke of Shuofang Commandery and King of the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the eleventh month Anagui was made Duke of Shuofang and King of the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，詔送蠕蠕王阿那瑰歸北。

translations.literal: On renzi day in the twelfth month an edict ordered the Rouran king Anagui sent back north.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the twelfth month he sent Anagui back north.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以司空、京兆王繼為司徒。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Minister of Works Ji, Prince of Jingzhao, was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Ji of Jingzhao became Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，南秦州氐反。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year the Di of Southern Qin Province rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year two the Di of Southern Qin rose.

sentences.zh: 二月，車駕幸國子學，講《孝經》。

translations.literal: In the second month the imperial carriage visited the Directorate of the Sons of the State and lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he visited the Directorate and lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，幸國子學，祠孔子，以顏回配。

translations.literal: On gengwu day he visited the Directorate of the Sons of the State, sacrificed to Confucius, and made Yan Hui his associate in the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he visited the Directorate, sacrificed to Confucius, and paired Yan Hui with him.

sentences.zh: 甲午，右衛將軍奚康生於禁中將殺元叉，不果，為叉所害。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the Right Guard General Xi Kangsheng attempted to kill Yuan Cha in the palace but did not succeed and was killed by Cha.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Xi Kangsheng tried to kill Yuan Cha in the palace, failed, and was killed by Cha.

sentences.zh: 以儀同三司劉騰為司空。

translations.literal: Liu Teng, with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Teng, with Three Excellencies privilege, became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，進司徒、京兆王繼位太保。

translations.literal: On gengzi day in the fourth month of summer Minister of Education Ji, Prince of Jingzhao, was advanced to Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the fourth summer month Ji of Jingzhao was promoted to Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以儀同三司崔光為司徒。

translations.literal: On renyin day Cui Guang, with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies, was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Cui Guang, with Three Excellencies privilege, became Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the first day of the fifth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, dingyou, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，以旱故，詔有司修案舊典，祗行六事。

translations.literal: On jichou day in the seventh month of autumn, because of drought, an edict ordered the relevant offices to examine the old statutes and reverently carry out the six measures.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the seventh autumn month, for drought, he ordered the six drought rites by old statute.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，蠕蠕後主郁久閭侯匿代來奔懷朔鎮。

translations.literal: On jisi day the former ruler of the Rouran, Yujiulü Houyidai, came in flight to Huaishuo Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the former Rouran ruler Houyidai fled to Huaishuo Garrison.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，詔司徒崔光、安豐王延明等議定服章。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day in the twelfth month an edict ordered Minister of Education Cui Guang, Prince of Anfeng Yanming, and others to deliberate on fixing robes and insignia.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the twelfth month he charged Cui Guang and Yanming of Anfeng to fix robes and insignia.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以東益、南秦州氐反，詔河間王琛討之，失利。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, because the Di of Eastern Yizhou and Southern Qin Province rebelled, an edict ordered Prince of Hejian Chen to suppress them; he suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, with the Di of Eastern Yi and Southern Qin in revolt, he sent Chen of Hejian against them; Chen was beaten.

sentences.zh: 是歲，烏萇、居密、波斯、高昌、勿吉、伏羅、高車等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Wusan, Jumi, Persia, Gaochang, Wuji, Yefulu, Gaoche, and other states sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Wusan, Persia, Gaochang, Gaoche, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛亥，耕籍田。

translations.literal: On xinhai day in the first month of the third year he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the first month of year three he plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，以高車國主覆羅伊匐為鎮西將軍、西海郡公、高車國王。

translations.literal: On gengchen day in the fourth month of summer the king of Gaoche, Fuluo Yifu, was made General Who Guards the West, Duke of Xihai Commandery, and King of Gaoche.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the fourth summer month Fuluo Yifu of Gaoche was made General Who Guards the West, Duke of Xihai, and King of Gaoche.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On renchen day, the first day of the fifth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, renchen, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，以旱故，詔分遣有司馳祈嶽瀆及諸山川百神能興雲雨者。

translations.literal: On jisi day in the sixth month, because of drought, an edict ordered separate parties sent to pray urgently at the mountains and rivers and the hundred spirits able to raise clouds and rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the sixth month, for drought, he sent envoys to pray at rivers, mountains, and rain spirits.

sentences.zh: 命理冤獄，止土功，減膳徹懸，禁止屠殺。

translations.literal: Wrongful cases were judged, earthworks halted, meals reduced and bells removed, and slaughter forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: He judged wrongful suits, halted earthworks, ate sparingly, silenced music, and banned killing.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On jichou day, the first day of the eleventh month of winter, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh winter month, jichou, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，祀圓丘。

translations.literal: On jisi day the suburban altar was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he sacrificed at the Round Altar.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔班歷，大赦。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the calendar was promulgated and a general amnesty proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he promulgated the calendar and pardoned the realm.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，以太保、京兆王繼為太傅，司徒崔光為太保。

translations.literal: On guiyou day in the twelfth month Grand Tutor Ji, Prince of Jingzhao, was made Grand Preceptor and Minister of Education Cui Guang Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the twelfth month Ji of Jingzhao became Grand Preceptor and Cui Guang Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 是歲，波斯、不溪、龜茲、吐谷渾並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Persia, Buxi, Kucha, and Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Persia, Buxi, Kucha, and Tuyuhun sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年春二月壬申，追封故咸陽王禧為敷城王，京兆王愉為臨洮王，清河王懌為范陽王，以禮加葬。

translations.literal: On renshen day in the second month of the fourth year the late Prince of Xianyang Xi was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Fucheng, Prince of Jingzhao Yu as Prince of Lintao, and Prince of Qinghe Yi as Prince of Fanyang, and they were buried with full rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the second month of year four Xi of Xianyang was posthumously made Prince of Fucheng, Yu of Jingzhao Prince of Lintao, and Yi of Qinghe Prince of Fanyang, with full burial rites.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，河間王琛、章武王融並以貪汙削爵除名。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Prince of Hejian Chen and Prince of Zhangwu Rong were both stripped of rank for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Chen of Hejian and Rong of Zhangwu were disgraced for corruption.

sentences.zh: 己卯，蠕蠕主阿那瑰率眾犯塞。

translations.literal: On jimao day the Rouran ruler Anagui led his host to raid the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Anagui of the Rouran raided the border with his host.

sentences.zh: 遣尚書左丞元孚為北道行臺，持節喻之。

translations.literal: The Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Assistant Yuan Fu, was sent as commander of the northern route with staff of authority to instruct him.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Fu, Left Assistant Director, was sent north with authority to instruct him.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕後主郁久閭侯匿代來朝。

translations.literal: The former Rouran ruler Yujiulü Houyidai came to court.
translations.idiomatic: The former Rouran ruler Houyidai came to court.

sentences.zh: 司空劉騰薨。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Liu Teng died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Teng, Minister of Works, died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，阿那瑰執元孚北遁。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Anagui seized Yuan Fu and fled north.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Anagui seized Yuan Fu and fled north.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸未，追復故范陽王懌為河間王。

translations.literal: On guiwei day in the eighth month of autumn the late Prince of Fanyang Yi was posthumously restored as Prince of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the eighth autumn month the late Yi of Fanyang was restored as Prince of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，詔太尉、汝南王悅入居門下，與丞相、高陽王雍參決尚書奏事。

translations.literal: On dingyou day in the ninth month an edict ordered Grand Commandant Yu, Prince of Runan, to enter the Gate Department and join Chancellor Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, in deciding memorials to the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the ninth month he ordered Yu of Runan into the Gate Department with Chancellor Yong of Gaoyang to decide secretariat memorials.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, the first day of the eleventh month of winter, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh winter month, guiwei, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，趙郡王謐薨。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Prince of Zhao Jun Mi died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Mi, Prince of Zhao, died.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太保崔光薨。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Grand Tutor Cui Guang died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Grand Tutor Cui Guang died.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以太尉、汝南王悅為太保。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Grand Commandant Yu, Prince of Runan, was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Yu of Runan became Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 徐州刺史、北海王顥坐貪汙，削爵除官。

translations.literal: The Inspector of Xuzhou, Prince of Beihai Hao, was sentenced for corruption and stripped of rank and office.
translations.idiomatic: Hao of Beihai, inspector of Xuzhou, was disgraced for corruption.

sentences.zh: 是歲，宕昌、庫莫奚國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Dangchang and the Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Dangchang and the Kumo Xi sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛丑，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On xinchou day in the first month of the fifth year the southern suburb was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the first month of year five he sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 三月，沃野鎮人破六韓拔陵反，聚眾殺鎮將，號真王元年。

translations.literal: In the third month the people of Woye Garrison, Poliuhan Baling, rebelled, gathered a crowd, killed the garrison commander, and styled the era True King year one.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Baling of Woye Garrison rebelled, killed the commander, and declared the era True King.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，高平酋長胡琛反，自稱高平王，攻鎮以應拔陵。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer the Di chieftain Hu Chen of Gaoping rebelled, styled himself King of Gaoping, and attacked the garrison in support of Baling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Hu Chen of Gaoping rebelled as King of Gaoping and struck the garrison for Baling.

sentences.zh: 別將盧祖遷擊破之。

translations.literal: The separate commander Lu Zuqian routed him.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zuqian, separate commander, beat him.

sentences.zh: 五月，都督北征諸軍事、臨淮王彧攻討，敗於五原，削除官爵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the area commander of the northern campaign, Prince of Linhuai Yu, attacked and was defeated at Wuyuan; his rank and office were removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Yu of Linhuai, northern commander, was beaten at Wuyuan and disgraced.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔尚書令李崇為大都督，率廣陽王淵等北討。

translations.literal: On renshen day an edict made the Director of the Masters of Writing Li Chong Grand Commander with Princes Yuan of Guangyang and others to campaign north.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he made Li Chong, Director of the Masters of Writing, Grand Commander with Yuan of Guangyang and others to march north.

sentences.zh: 六月，秦州城人莫折大提據城反，自稱秦王，殺刺史李彥。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the people of Qinzhou city, Moqi Datí, held the city in rebellion, styled himself King of Qin, and killed the inspector Li Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Moqi Datí of Qinzhou seized the city as King of Qin and killed Inspector Li Yan.

sentences.zh: 大提尋死，子念生代立，僭稱天子，年號天建，置立百官。

translations.literal: Datí soon died; his son Niansheng succeeded, usurped the title of emperor, with era name Tianjian, and established the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: Datí soon died; his son Niansheng succeeded as emperor under the era Tianjian and set up a full court.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大赦。

translations.literal: On dingyou day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he pardoned the realm.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，復河間王琛、臨淮王彧本封。

translations.literal: On wuwu day in the seventh month of autumn the original enfeoffments of Prince of Hejian Chen and Prince of Linhuai Yu were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the seventh autumn month Chen of Hejian and Yu of Linhuai received their titles again.

sentences.zh: 是月，涼州幢帥於菩提、呼延雄執刺史宋潁，據州反。

translations.literal: That month the chieftains of Liang Province, Yu Puti and Huyan Xiong, seized the inspector Song Ying and held the province in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: That month Puti and Xiong of Liang seized Inspector Song Ying and held the province.

sentences.zh: 念生遣其兄高陽王天生下隴東寇。

translations.literal: Niansheng sent his elder brother, Prince of Gaoyang Tiansheng, east down Long to raid.
translations.idiomatic: Niansheng sent his brother Tiansheng of Gaoyang east down Long to raid.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，雍州刺史元誌西討，大敗於隴東，退守岐州。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the Inspector of Yong, Yuan Zhi, campaigned west and suffered great defeat east of Long; he withdrew to defend Qi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Yuan Zhi of Yong marched west, was crushed east of Long, and withdrew to Qi.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔諸州鎮軍元非犯配者，悉免為編戶。

translations.literal: On bingshen day an edict ordered that in the provinces and garrisons, military men not guilty of capital crimes matching exile were all freed to registered households.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he freed non-capital military exiles in provinces and garrisons to common registers.

sentences.zh: 改鎮為州，依舊立稱。

translations.literal: Garrisons were changed to provinces and the old names were established.
translations.idiomatic: Garrisons became provinces under their old names.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，詔尚書左僕射、齊王蕭寶夤為西道行臺、大都督。

translations.literal: On renshen day in the ninth month an edict made the Left Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Qi Xiao Baoyin, commander of the western route with staff of authority and Grand Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the ninth month Baoyin of Qi was made western commander with Grand Commander's staff.

sentences.zh: 復撫軍、北海王顥官爵，為都督。

translations.literal: The Army-quelling General, Prince of Beihai Hao, had his rank and office restored and was made area commander.
translations.idiomatic: Hao of Beihai, Army-quelling General, was restored and made commander.

sentences.zh: 並率諸將西討。

translations.literal: Together they led the generals west.
translations.idiomatic: They led the generals west together.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，帝幸明堂，餞寶夤等。

translations.literal: On yihai day the Emperor visited the Bright Hall to feast Baoyin and the others.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he feasted Baoyin and the others at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾主伏連籌遣兵討涼州。

translations.literal: The ruler of Tuyuhun, Fulian Chou, sent troops to campaign against Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Fulian Chou of Tuyuhun sent troops against Liang.

sentences.zh: 於菩提走，追斬之。

translations.literal: Puti fled and was pursued and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Puti fled and was pursued and killed.

sentences.zh: 城人趙天安復推宋潁為刺史。

translations.literal: The people of the city again installed Song Ying as inspector.
translations.idiomatic: The city men again made Song Ying inspector.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，營州城人劉安定、就德興據城反，執刺史李仲遵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter the people of Yingzhou city, Liu Anding and Jiudexing, held the city in rebellion and seized the inspector Li Zhongzun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Liu Anding and Jiudexing of Yingzhou seized the city and took Inspector Li Zhongzun.

sentences.zh: 城人王惡兒斬安定以降。

translations.literal: Wang E'er of the city beheaded Anding and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Wang E'er of the city killed Anding and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 德興東走，自號燕王。

translations.literal: Dexing fled east and styled himself King of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Dexing fled east and called himself King of Yan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔太傅、京兆王繼為太師、大將軍，率諸將西討。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month an edict made Grand Preceptor Ji, Prince of Jingzhao, Grand Preceptor and Grand General and led the generals west.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Ji of Jingzhao was made Grand Preceptor and Grand General and marched west.

sentences.zh: 汾州正平、平陽胡叛逆，詔復征東將軍、章武王融封爵，為大都督，率眾討之。

translations.literal: The Hu of Zhengping and Pingyang in Fenzhou rebelled; an edict restored the enfeoffment of Rong, Prince of Zhangwu, General Who Conquers the East, and made him Grand Commander to lead the host against them.
translations.idiomatic: The Hu of Fenzhou rebelled; Rong of Zhangwu was restored and sent as Grand Commander against them.

sentences.zh: 莫折念生遣兵攻涼州，城人趙天安復執刺史以應之。

translations.literal: Niansheng sent troops to attack Liang Province; the people of the city again seized the inspector to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Niansheng attacked Liang; the city men again seized the inspector for him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，嚈噠、契丹、地豆幹、庫莫奚等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year the Hephthalites, Khitan, Didougan, Kumo Xi, and other states sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Hephthalites, Khitan, Didougan, Kumo Xi, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月，詔追復故樂良王長命爵，以其子忠紹之。

translations.literal: In the second month an edict posthumously restored the rank of the late Prince of Leliang Changming and had his son Zhong succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the late Changming of Leliang was restored and his son Zhong succeeded.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大赦。

translations.literal: On wuxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he pardoned the realm.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，詔五品以上，各薦所知。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day in the third month an edict ordered that officials of the fifth rank and above each recommend men they knew.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the third month he ordered every officer of the fifth rank and above to recommend talent.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，皇太后復臨朝攝政，引群臣面陳得失。

translations.literal: On xinmao day in the fourth month of summer the empress dowager again held court and governed, summoning the ministers to state gains and losses face to face.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the fourth summer month the empress dowager ruled again and summoned ministers to speak face to face.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，征西將軍、都督崔延伯大敗於涇川，戰歿。

translations.literal: On renchen day the General Who Conquers the West and area commander Cui Yanbo suffered great defeat at Jingchuan and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Cui Yanbo, General Who Conquers the West, was crushed at Jingchuan and died.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On guiwei day in the sixth month a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the sixth month he pardoned the realm and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕主阿那瑰大破拔陵。

translations.literal: That month the Rouran ruler Anagui routed Baling.
translations.idiomatic: That month Anagui of the Rouran routed Baling.

sentences.zh: 是月，諸將逼彭城，蕭綜夜潛出降，梁諸將奔退，眾軍追躡，免者十一二。

translations.literal: That month the generals pressed Pengcheng; Xiao Zong slipped out by night and surrendered; the Liang generals fled in rout; the armies pursued, and only one or two in ten escaped.
translations.idiomatic: That month the generals closed on Pengcheng; Zong of Liang slipped out by night and surrendered; the Liang commanders fled; pursuers left only one or two in ten.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸酉，詔斷遠近貢獻珍麗，違者免官。

translations.literal: On guiyou day in the eighth month of autumn an edict forbade tribute of precious and rare goods from near and far on pain of removal from office.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the eighth autumn month he forbade tribute of rare luxuries on pain of dismissal.

sentences.zh: 柔玄鎮人杜洛周反於上谷，年號真王。

translations.literal: The people of Rouxuan Garrison, Du Luozhou, rebelled at Shanggu with era name True King.
translations.idiomatic: Du Luozhou of Rouxuan rebelled at Shanggu as True King.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，詔減天下諸調之半。

translations.literal: On yimao day in the ninth month an edict halved all levies throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the ninth month he halved every levy in the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔五品以上，各舉所知。

translations.literal: On renxu day an edict ordered that officials of the fifth rank and above each present men they knew.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he ordered every officer of the fifth rank and above to present known talent.

sentences.zh: 辛未，曲赦南北秦州。

translations.literal: On xinwei day a partial amnesty was granted for Southern and Northern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he pardoned Southern and Northern Qin in part.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，蠕蠕遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter the Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the Rouran sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，詔父母年八十以上者，皆聽居官。

translations.literal: On xinhai day in the eleventh month an edict ordered that those whose parents were eighty or older might all remain in office near home.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the eleventh month he let every man whose parents were eighty or older stay in office near home.

sentences.zh: 時四方多事，諸蠻復反。

translations.literal: At the time trouble was widespread in the four quarters and the various barbarians rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Trouble spread in every quarter and the barbarians rose again.

sentences.zh: 十二月，山胡劉蠡升反，自稱天子。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Liu Lisheng of the Mountain Hu rebelled and styled himself Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Liu Lisheng of the Mountain Hu rebelled as Son of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚戌，封廣平王懷長子誨為范陽王。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, on gengxu day, Hui, eldest son of Prince of Guangping Huai, was enfeoffed as Prince of Fanyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year two, on gengxu day, Hui, eldest son of Huai of Guangping, was made Prince of Fanyang.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以太保、汝南王悅領太尉。

translations.literal: On renzi day Grand Tutor Yu, Prince of Runan, was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yu of Runan became Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 是月，五原鮮于修禮反於定州，年號魯興。

translations.literal: That month Xianyu Xiuli of Wuyuan rebelled at Ding Province with era name Luxing.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiuli of Wuyuan rebelled in Ding under the era Luxing.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，帝及皇太后臨大夏門，親覽冤訟。

translations.literal: On gengshen day in the second month the Emperor and empress dowager attended the Daxia Gate and personally reviewed wrongful lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the second month the emperor and empress dowager sat at the Daxia Gate and judged wrongs.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，追復中山王熙本爵，以其子叔仁紹之。

translations.literal: On gengzi day in the third month the original rank of Prince of Zhongshan Xi was posthumously restored and his son Shuren succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the third month Xi of Zhongshan was restored posthumously and his son Shuren succeeded.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，大赦。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month he pardoned the realm.

sentences.zh: 戊申，北討都督河間王琛、長孫承業失利奔還，詔並免官爵。

translations.literal: On wushen day the northern campaign area commanders Prince of Hejian Chen and Yuwen Chengye suffered defeat and fled back; an edict stripped them both of rank and office.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Chen of Hejian and Yuwen Chengye, northern commanders, were beaten and fled; both were disgraced.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，車駕將北討，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On dingwei day in the fifth month the imperial carriage was to campaign north; within and without the realm were placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the fifth month the emperor prepared a northern campaign and the realm was put on alert.

sentences.zh: 前給事黃門侍郎元略自梁還朝，封義陽王。

translations.literal: Yuan Lue, former Attendant of the Masters of Writing in the Yellow Gate, returned from Liang and was enfeoffed as Prince of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Lue, former Yellow Gate attendant, returned from Liang and was made Prince of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 以丞相、高陽王雍為大司馬。

translations.literal: Chancellor Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, was made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Yong of Gaoyang became Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，曲赦齊州。

translations.literal: On jisi day in the sixth month a partial amnesty was granted for Qi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the sixth month he pardoned Qi in part.

sentences.zh: 絳蜀陳雙熾聚眾反，自號始建王。

translations.literal: Chen Shuangchi of Jiang and Shu gathered a crowd in rebellion and styled himself King Shijian.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shuangchi of Jiang and Shu rebelled as King Shijian.

sentences.zh: 曲赦平陽、建興、正平三郡。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted for Pingyang, Jianxing, and Zhengping commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: He pardoned Pingyang, Jianxing, and Zhengping in part.

sentences.zh: 詔假鎮西將軍、都督長孫承業討雙熾，平之。

translations.literal: An edict made the acting General Who Guards the West and area commander Yuwen Chengye campaign against Shuangchi and pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Yuwen Chengye, acting General Who Guards the West, against Shuangchi and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 丙子，改封義陽王略為東平王。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Prince of Yiyang Lue was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Lue of Yiyang was made Prince of Dongping.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔復京兆王繼本封江陽王。

translations.literal: On wuyin day an edict restored the original enfeoffment of Prince of Jingzhao Ji as Prince of Jiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Ji of Jingzhao was restored as Prince of Jiangyang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔曰：「自運屬艱棘，歷載於茲。

translations.literal: On wuzi day an edict said: "Since fate turned harsh, years have piled up here.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he proclaimed: "Since fortune turned harsh, years have heaped upon us.

sentences.zh: 朕威德不能遐被，經略無以及遠，何以茍安黃屋，無愧黔黎！

translations.literal: My authority and virtue cannot reach far; strategy cannot extend afar; how can I dwell at ease in the yellow canopy without shame before the black-haired people!
translations.idiomatic: My power cannot reach far nor my plans extend; how can I sit beneath the yellow canopy unashamed before the people!

sentences.zh: 今便避居正殿，蔬食素服。

translations.literal: From now I shall withdraw to the main hall, eat vegetables and wear plain clothes.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth I withdraw to the main hall, eat vegetables, and wear plain dress.

sentences.zh: 當親自招募，收集忠勇。

translations.literal: I shall personally recruit and gather the loyal and brave.
translations.idiomatic: I shall recruit the loyal and brave myself.

sentences.zh: 其有直言正諫之士，敢決徇義之夫，二十五日，悉集華林東門。

translations.literal: Let men who speak straight and counsel rightly and dare die for justice assemble at the east gate of Hualin on the twenty-fifth day.
translations.idiomatic: Let every man who speaks straight or dies for justice gather at the east gate of Hualin on the twenty-fifth.

sentences.zh: 人別引見，共論得失。

translations.literal: Each shall be led in separately to discuss gains and losses together.
translations.idiomatic: Each shall be received alone to debate what is right and wrong.

sentences.zh: 」秋八月丙子，進封廣川縣公元為常山王。

translations.literal: On bingzi day in the eighth month of autumn Yuan of Guangchuan County was advanced to Prince of Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the eighth autumn month Yuan of Guangchuan was made Prince of Changshan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，進武城縣公子攸為長樂王。

translations.literal: On wuzi day You, Duke of Wucheng County, was advanced to Prince of Changle.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi You of Wucheng was made Prince of Changle.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賊帥元洪業斬鮮于修禮請降，為賊黨葛榮所殺。

translations.literal: On guisi day the bandit leader Yuan Hongye beheaded Xianyu Xiuli and requested surrender but was killed by the bandit Ge Rong.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the bandit Yuan Hongye killed Xiuli and offered surrender, but Ge Rong killed him.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，葛榮敗都督廣陽王深、章武王融於博野白牛邏。

translations.literal: On xinhai day in the ninth month Ge Rong defeated the area commanders Prince of Guangyang Shen and Prince of Zhangwu Rong at the White Ox Pasture of Boye.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the ninth month Ge Rong crushed Shen of Guangyang and Rong of Zhangwu at the White Ox Pasture of Boye.

sentences.zh: 融歿於陣。

translations.literal: Rong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Rong died on the field.

sentences.zh: 榮自稱天子，國號齊，年稱廣安。

translations.literal: Rong styled himself Son of Heaven; his state was named Qi and his era Guang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Rong called himself Son of Heaven, named his state Qi, and took the era Guang'an.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊戌，杜洛周攻陷幽州，執刺史王延年及行臺常景。

translations.literal: On wuxu day in the eleventh month of winter Du Luozhou captured You Province, seized the inspector Wang Yannian and the acting commander Chang Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the eleventh winter month Du Luozhou took You, seized Inspector Wang Yannian and Acting Commander Chang Jing.

sentences.zh: 丙午，稅京師田租，畝五升。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the land tax of the capital region was levied at five sheng per mu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he levied the capital land tax at five sheng per mu.

sentences.zh: 借賃公田者，畝一斗。

translations.literal: Those renting public fields paid one dou per mu.
translations.idiomatic: Tenants of public fields paid one dou per mu.

sentences.zh: 閏月，稅市，人出入者，各一錢，店舍為五等。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month a market tax was levied: each person entering or leaving paid one cash; shops were taxed in five grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the leap month he taxed the markets: one cash per person in or out, and shops in five grades.

sentences.zh: 梁將元樹逼壽春，揚州刺史李憲力屈而降。

translations.literal: The Liang general Yuan Shu pressed Shouchun; the Inspector of Yang Li Xian, strength exhausted, surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shu of Liang pressed Shouchun; Li Xian of Yang, strength spent, surrendered.

sentences.zh: 初留州縣及長史、司馬、戍主副質子於京師。

translations.literal: At first the provincial and commandery officials and the chief clerks, area commanders, garrison commanders, and their deputies were detained as hostages in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At first provincial and garrison officers were held as hostages in the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔：「頃舊京淪覆，中原喪亂，宗室子女屬籍在七廟內為雜戶濫門拘辱者，悉聽離絕。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Recently the old capital fell, the central plain was lost in chaos, and imperial clansmen and daughters whose registers lay within the seven temples but who were held as mixed households and insulted by the base gates may all sever the tie."
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed: "Since the old capital fell, clansmen held as base household slaves may all go free."

sentences.zh: 」是歲，疊伏羅、庫莫奚國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year the states of Diefuluo and Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Diefuluo and the Kumo Xi sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲戌，以司空皇甫度為司徒，儀同三司蕭寶夤為司空。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day in the first month of the third year Minister of Works Huangfu Du was made Minister of Education and Xiao Baoyin, with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies, Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the first month of year three Huangfu Du became Minister of Education and Baoyin of Qi, with Three Excellencies privilege, Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，葛榮陷殷州，刺史崔楷固節死之。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Ge Rong captured Yin Province; the inspector Cui Kai held firm to integrity and died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Ge Rong took Yin; Inspector Cui Kai died holding his post.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔峻鑄錢之制。

translations.literal: On jiashen day an edict tightened the system for casting coin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he tightened the coinage.

sentences.zh: 蕭寶夤大敗於涇州，北海王顥尋亦敗走。

translations.literal: Xiao Baoyin suffered great defeat in Jing Province; Prince of Beihai Hao soon fled in defeat as well.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyin of Qi was crushed in Jing; Hao of Beihai soon fled in defeat.

sentences.zh: 曲赦關西及正平、平陽、建興。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted for Guanxi and Zhengping, Pingyang, and Jianxing.
translations.idiomatic: He pardoned Guanxi, Zhengping, Pingyang, and Jianxing in part.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以司徒皇甫度為太尉。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Minister of Education Huangfu Du was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Huangfu Du became Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以四方未平，詔內外戒嚴，將親征。

translations.literal: On jichou day, because the four quarters were not yet pacified, an edict placed the realm on alert within and without; the Emperor was to campaign in person.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, with the realm still unsettled, he put the court on alert and prepared to campaign himself.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，詔開輸賞格。

translations.literal: On dingyou day in the second month an edict opened the reward schedule for grain contributions.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the second month he opened rewards for grain contributions.

sentences.zh: 輸粟入瀛、定、岐、雍四州者，官鬥二百斛賞一階；

translations.literal: Those who sent grain into Ying, Ding, Qi, and Yong provinces received one rank for every two hundred hu measured by the office dou;
translations.idiomatic: Grain into Ying, Ding, Qi, and Yong bought one rank per two hundred office hu;

sentences.zh: 入二華州者，五百石賞一階。

translations.literal: into the two Hua provinces, one rank for five hundred piculs.
translations.idiomatic: into the two Hua provinces, one rank per five hundred piculs.

sentences.zh: 不限多少，粟畢授官。

translations.literal: Without limit on amount, office was granted when the grain was delivered.
translations.idiomatic: Office followed the grain without limit.

sentences.zh: 虜賊據潼關。

translations.literal: Barbarian bandits held Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Barbarian rebels held Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，詔將西討，中外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On jiazi day in the third month an edict ordered a western campaign; within and without were placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the third month he ordered a western campaign and put the realm on alert.

sentences.zh: 虜賊走，復潼關。

translations.literal: The barbarian bandits fled and Tong Pass was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled and Tong Pass was recovered.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，相州刺史、安樂王鑒據州反。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn the Inspector of Xiang, Prince of Anle Jian, held the province in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Jian of Anle, inspector of Xiang, rebelled and held the province.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大赦。

translations.literal: On jichou day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he pardoned the realm.

sentences.zh: 八月，都督源子邕、李神軌、裴衍攻鄴。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the area commanders Yuan Ziyong, Li Shengui, and Pei Yan attacked Ye.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yuan Ziyong, Li Shengui, and Pei Yan besieged Ye.

sentences.zh: 丁未，斬鑒，相州平。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Jian was beheaded and Xiang Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Jian was beheaded and Xiang pacified.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，東豫州刺史元慶和以城南叛。

translations.literal: On jiwei day in the ninth month Yuan Qinghe, Inspector of Eastern Yuzhou, rebelled with the south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the ninth month Yuan Qinghe of Eastern Yu rebelled in the southern city.

sentences.zh: 秦州城人杜粲殺莫折念生，自行州事。

translations.literal: The people of Qinzhou city, Du Can, killed Moqi Niansheng and acted for the province themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Du Can of Qinzhou killed Moqi Niansheng and took the province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，曲赦恒農已西河北、正平、平陽、邵郡及關西諸州。

translations.literal: On wushen day in the tenth month of winter a partial amnesty was granted for Hengnong westward through Hebei, Zhengping, Pingyang, Shao Commandery, and the provinces of Guanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the tenth winter month he pardoned west of Hengnong through Hebei, Zhengping, Pingyang, Shao, and Guanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，雍州刺史蕭寶夤據州反，自號齊，年稱隆緒。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the Inspector of Yong, Xiao Baoyin, held the province in rebellion, styled his state Qi, and took the era Longxu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Baoyin of Yong rebelled, called his state Qi, and took the era Longxu.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑，葛榮攻陷冀州，執刺史元孚，逐出居人，凍死者十六七。

translations.literal: On jichou day in the eleventh month Ge Rong captured Ji Province, seized the inspector Yuan Fu, drove out the inhabitants, and sixteen or seventeen in ten died of cold.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the eleventh month Ge Rong took Ji, seized Yuan Fu, expelled the people, and sixteen or seventeen in ten froze to death.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，都督源子邕、裴衍與榮戰，敗於陽平東北，並歿。

translations.literal: On wushen day in the twelfth month the area commanders Yuan Ziyong and Pei Yan fought Ge Rong, were defeated northeast of Yangping, and both died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the twelfth month Yuan Ziyong and Pei Yan fought Ge Rong northeast of Yangping and both fell.

sentences.zh: 是月，杜粲為駱超所殺。

translations.literal: That month Du Can was killed by Luo Chao.
translations.idiomatic: That month Luo Chao killed Du Can.

sentences.zh: 超遣使歸罪。

translations.literal: Chao sent envoys to declare guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Chao sent envoys to confess guilt.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year the Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Rouran sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 武泰元年春正月乙丑，生皇女，秘言皇子。

translations.literal: On yichou day in the first month of the first year of Wutai a princess was born; it was secretly announced as a prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the first month of Wutai year one a princess was born, but the court announced a prince.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On bingyin day a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he pardoned the realm and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，雍州人侯終德相率攻蕭寶夤。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the people of Yong, Hou Zhongde and others, together attacked Xiao Baoyin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Hou Zhongde of Yong and others attacked Baoyin together.

sentences.zh: 寶夤度渭走，雍州平。

translations.literal: Baoyin crossed the Wei and fled; Yong Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyin crossed the Wei and fled; Yong was pacified.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，帝崩於顯陽殿，時年十九。

translations.literal: On guichou day in the second month the Emperor died in the Xuanyang Hall at the age of nineteen.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the second month the emperor died in Xuanyang Hall, aged nineteen.

sentences.zh: 幼主釗

translations.literal: The infant ruler Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: The infant ruler Zhao.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，皇子即位，大赦。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the prince took the throne and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the prince ascended the throne and the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 皇太后詔曰：「皇家握歷受圖，年將二百，祖宗累聖，社稷載安。

translations.literal: An edict of the empress dowager said: "The imperial house has held the calendar and received the mandate for nearly two hundred years; the ancestors in succession were sage and the altars have long stood secure.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager proclaimed: "Our house has held the mandate nearly two hundred years; sage ancestors have kept the altars secure.

sentences.zh: 高祖以文思先天，世宗以下武繼世。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu with civil thought preceded Heaven; Emperor Shizong with martial virtue succeeded the age.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu led with civil virtue; Shizong followed with martial worth.

sentences.zh: 大行在御，重以寬仁奉養，率由溫明恭順。

translations.literal: The late emperor on the throne again nourished the realm with breadth and kindness, following warmth, clarity, respect, and obedience.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor ruled with breadth and kindness, warm, clear, respectful, and obedient.

sentences.zh: 實望穹靈降佑，麟趾眾繁。

translations.literal: We truly hoped the dome would send blessing and many unicorn sons would flourish.
translations.idiomatic: We hoped Heaven would bless us with many heirs.

sentences.zh: 自潘充華有孕椒宮，冀誕儲兩，而熊羆無兆，唯虺遂彰。

translations.literal: When Lady Pan Chonghua of the Pepper Palace conceived, we hoped for the heir; yet the bear sign did not appear and only the serpent was revealed.
translations.idiomatic: When Lady Pan conceived in the Pepper Palace we hoped for an heir, but no bear appeared and only the serpent was shown.

sentences.zh: 於時直以國步未康，假稱統胤。

translations.literal: At the time, because the realm was not yet at peace, we falsely named him heir.
translations.idiomatic: Because the realm was still unsettled we falsely named a prince.

sentences.zh: 欲以底定物情，系仰宸極。

translations.literal: We wished thereby to settle the feelings of things and bind all eyes to the pole.
translations.idiomatic: We meant to steady the realm and bind all eyes to the throne.

sentences.zh: 何圖一旦弓劍莫追！

translations.literal: Who could have thought that in a single morning bow and sword could not be followed!
translations.idiomatic: Who thought that in one morning bow and sword would be beyond recall!

sentences.zh: 皇曾孫故臨洮王寶暉世子釗，體自高祖，天表卓異。

translations.literal: The late emperor's great-grandson, the heir of the late Prince of Lintao, Bao Zhao, is of Gaozu's line and his heavenly countenance is surpassing.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor's great-grandson Zhao, heir of the late Prince of Lintao, is of Gaozu's line and bears a surpassing countenance.

sentences.zh: 大行平日養愛特深，義齊若子，事符當璧，允膺大寶。

translations.literal: The late emperor in his daily life cherished him especially; his affection matched that for a son, and the matter accorded with the jade disk; he is fit to receive the great treasure.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor cherished him as a son; he is fit for the great treasure.

sentences.zh: 即日踐祚。

translations.literal: That very day he ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: That day he ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 可班宣遠邇，咸使知之。

translations.literal: Let it be proclaimed far and near that all may know.
translations.idiomatic: Let it be proclaimed far and near.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，幼主即位。

translations.literal: On yimao day the infant ruler took the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the infant ruler ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 儀同三司、大都督爾朱榮抗表請入奔赴，勒兵而南。

translations.literal: Erzhu Rong, with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies and Grand Commander, memorialized requesting entry to attend the funeral and led his army south.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Rong, with Three Excellencies privilege and as Grand Commander, asked to attend the funeral and marched south.

sentences.zh: 是月，杜洛周為葛榮所並。

translations.literal: That month Du Luozhou was absorbed by Ge Rong.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ge Rong absorbed Du Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，上尊謚曰孝明皇帝。

translations.literal: On jiashen day in the third month the honorific title Emperor Xiaoming was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the third month the posthumous title Emperor Xiaoming was granted.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，葬於定陵，廟號肅宗。

translations.literal: On yiyou day he was buried at Dingling; the temple name was Suzong.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he was buried at Dingling with the temple name Suzong.

sentences.zh: 四月戊戌，爾朱榮濟河。

translations.literal: On wuxu day in the fourth month Erzhu Rong crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the fourth month Erzhu Rong crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 庚子，皇太后、幼主崩。

translations.literal: On gengzi day the empress dowager and infant ruler died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the empress dowager and infant ruler died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：宣武承聖考德業，天下想望風化，垂拱無為，邊僥稽服。

translations.literal: The judgment says: Xuanwu inherited the virtue and enterprise of his sage father; the realm looked to his transforming wind, he ruled without action, and the frontier barbarians submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The judgment says: Xuanwu inherited his father's sage enterprise; the realm looked to his transforming rule, he governed without strain, and the frontier submitted.

sentences.zh: 而寬以攝下，從容不斷，太和之風替矣。

translations.literal: Yet he was lenient in governing below, unhurried and indecisive, and the wind of Taihe was lost.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was lenient below, slow and indecisive, and the Taihe age passed.

sentences.zh: 比之漢世，元、成、安、順之儔歟。

translations.literal: Compared to the Han, was he not the equal of Yuan, Cheng, An, and Shun?
translations.idiomatic: Among the Han he would rank with Yuan, Cheng, An, and Shun.

sentences.zh: 宣武之後，繼以元成，孝明沖齡統業，靈后婦人專制，任用非人，賞罰乖舛。

translations.literal: After Xuanwu came the Yuan and the Cheng; Xiaoming took the enterprise in tender years; the Ling empress, a woman, held sole power, employed unfit men, and rewards and punishments went awry.
translations.idiomatic: After Xuanwu came the Yuans and the Chengs; Xiaoming ruled as a child; the empress dowager, a woman, held sole power, used unfit men, and rewards and punishments went awry.

sentences.zh: 於是釁起宇內，禍延邦畿。

translations.literal: Then strife rose within the realm and disaster spread to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Strife rose within the realm and disaster reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 卒於享國不長，抑亦淪胥之始也。

translations.literal: In the end his holding of the state was not long; this too was the beginning of ruin.
translations.idiomatic: In the end his reign was brief; this was the beginning of ruin.
